source.text: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה שָׁנָ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of two [and] ten year[s was] Manasseh when he became king, and fifty and five year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem.

en.L: Manasseh [was] a son of twelve years when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
en.B: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
en.R: Manasseh became king at the age of twelve, and he ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-five years.

es.L: Hijo de doce años [era] Manasés cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó cincuenta y cinco años en Jerusalén.
es.B: Manasés tenía doce años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó cincuenta y cinco años en Jerusalén.
es.R: Manasés comenzó a reinar a los doce años, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante cincuenta y cinco años.

fr.L: Manassé [avait] douze ans quand il devint roi, et il régna cinquante-cinq ans à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Manassé avait douze ans quand il devint roi, et il régna cinquante-cinq ans à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Manassé avait douze ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant cinquante-cinq ans.

sw.L: Manase [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka kumi na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka hamsini na mitano huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Manase alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka hamsini na mitano huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Manase alianza kutawala akiwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka hamsini na mitano.

vi.L: Ma-na-se [được] mười hai tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì năm mươi lăm năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Ma-na-se được mười hai tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì năm mươi lăm năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Ma-na-se lên làm vua lúc mười hai tuổi, và vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem năm mươi lăm năm.

ko.L: 므낫세가 왕이 되었을 때 12세[였고], 예루살렘에서 55년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 므낫세는 12세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 55년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 므낫세는 12세에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 55년 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: Manassés [tinha] doze anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou cinquenta e cinco anos em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Manassés tinha doze anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou cinquenta e cinco anos em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Manassés tinha doze anos quando se tornou rei, e governou em Jerusalém durante cinquenta e cinco anos.

decisions.choice: the opening of Manasseh's reign: parallel to 2 Kings 21:1, without the queen mother
decisions.reason: Verses 1-10 follow 2 Kings 21:1-10 closely. Here the words are the same as in Kings, except that Chronicles leaves out the name of Manasseh's mother, Hephzibah. From Manasseh on, Chronicles no longer names the mothers of the kings of Judah, though Kings goes on doing so.

decisions.choice: a son of twelve years: twelve years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years, as in 27:1.

decisions.choice: fifty-five years: the longest reign of any king of Judah
decisions.reason: Manasseh followed his father Hezekiah (32:33). His reign is the longest of any king of Judah or Israel. The years may include a time when he shared the throne with his father, since Hezekiah was given fifteen more years after his illness (2 Kings 20:6) and Manasseh was only twelve when he became king.

decisions.choice: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years
decisions.reason: Worded as in 2 Kings 21:1 at each level, the accession formula kept throughout Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish 2 Kings 21:1
decisions.reason: The accession formula keeps the Spanish of 2 Kings 21:1 at each level, without the queen mother, as the Hebrew of Chronicles (m1); verses 1-9 keep the Kings wording wherever the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 2 Kings 21
decisions.reason: Verses 1-10 and 20-25 repeat the Swahili of 2 Kings 21:1-24 at each level, changing only what the Chronicles Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 21:1 without the queen mother
decisions.reason: Chronicles repeats 2 Kings 21:1 but leaves out the mother's name (m1); the Vietnamese Kings sentence is reused without it.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 21:1 without the mother's name, with figures at every level
decisions.reason: Chronicles leaves out Hephzibah (m1); ages and years are written in figures in this block.

decisions.choice: the accession formula of 2 Kings 21:1 in Portuguese, without the queen mother
decisions.reason: Verses 1-10 follow 2 Kings 21:1-10 (m1), so they keep the Portuguese of that passage level by level where the Hebrew is the same, and change only what Chronicles changes; here Chronicles leaves out the mother's name, so the sentence ends at "Jerusalém". "Manassés" as the Old Testament names have it.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּתֽוֹעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, according to [the] abominations of the nations which dispossessed Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to the abominations of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, following the detestable practices of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. He copied the disgusting things that the nations had done before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} forced them out of the land for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a las abominaciones de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, siguiendo las prácticas detestables de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los israelitas.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba. Imitó las cosas repugnantes que hacían las naciones antes de que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} las echara de la tierra para dar lugar a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon les abominations des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dépossédées devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon les pratiques abominables des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassées devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais. Il a imité les choses dégoûtantes que faisaient les peuples que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassés du pays pour les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na machukizo ya mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akifuata desturi za kuchukiza za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya. Aliiga mambo ya kuchukiza yaliyofanywa na mataifa kabla {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hajayafukuza kutoka katika nchi kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo các điều ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi khỏi trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo những thói ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi đi trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Vua bắt chước những việc ghê tởm mà các dân tộc đã làm trước khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đuổi họ ra khỏi xứ để nhường chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 가증한 일들을 따라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 역겨운 관습을 따라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 사람들을 위해 그 땅에서 쫓아내신 민족들이 하던 끔찍한 일들을 그대로 따라 했다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, conforme as abominações das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, seguindo as coisas abomináveis das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos israelitas.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau. Imitou as coisas abomináveis que faziam as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado da terra para dar lugar aos israelitas.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 21:2
decisions.reason: The verse is word for word the same as 2 Kings 21:2, and is worded the same way here.

decisions.choice: did what was evil in Yahweh's eyes: the bad verdict
decisions.reason: The verdict of the regnal formula. Manasseh's father Hezekiah had done what was right (29:2); the son undoes his father's work.

decisions.choice: abominations: practices Yahweh detests
decisions.reason: The word is used for what is utterly offensive to Yahweh, especially the worship and customs of the Canaanite nations. Deuteronomy 18:9-12 uses it of the very practices listed in verses 3-6.

decisions.choice: the nations Yahweh drove out: Judah takes up the sins for which the land was taken from them
decisions.reason: The nations lost the land because of these practices (Leviticus 18:24-28; Deuteronomy 9:4-5). If Judah does the same, it faces the same end.

decisions.choice: did the evil in [the] eyes of / did what was evil in the sight of / did what the LORD said was evil; abominations / detestable practices / disgusting things
decisions.reason: The verdict formula and the word for abominations, worded at each level as in 2 Kings 21:2.

decisions.choice: the wording of French 2 Kings 21:2 at each level
decisions.reason: The Chronicles verse has the same Hebrew, so the French of Kings is kept, with its gender spans.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender setting
decisions.reason: The verse is 2 Kings 21:2 in Portuguese word for word at each level (m1), the verdict formula and "abominações" (L), "coisas abomináveis" (B, R) included. As the Old Testament terms set it, "filhos" and "israelitas" already include women, so there is no gender setting where the English has one.

source.text: וַיָּ֗שָׁב וַיִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת־הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּ֖ץ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּ֨קֶם מִזְבְּח֤וֹת לַבְּעָלִים֙ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֲשֵׁר֔וֹת וַיִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ לְכָל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he returned and built the high places which had pulled down Hezekiah his father, and he set up altars for the Baals, and he made Asherahs, and he bowed down to all [the] host of the heavens and served them.

en.L: And he again built the high places that Hezekiah his father had pulled down, and he set up altars for the Baals and made Asherah poles, and he bowed down to all the host of the heavens and served them.
en.B: He rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had pulled down. He set up altars for the Baals and made Asherah poles. He bowed down to all the host of heaven and served them.
en.R: He built again the hilltop shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He set up altars to worship the Baals, and he made poles used to worship Asherah. He bowed down to the sun, moon and stars and worshiped them.

es.L: Y volvió a edificar los lugares altos que Ezequías su padre había derribado, y levantó altares a los baales, e hizo postes de Aserá, y se postró ante todo el ejército de los cielos y les sirvió.
es.B: Reconstruyó los lugares altos que su padre Ezequías había derribado. Levantó altares a los baales e hizo postes de Aserá. Se postró ante todo el ejército de los cielos y les sirvió.
es.R: Volvió a construir los santuarios sobre las colinas que su padre Ezequías había derribado. Levantó altares para adorar a los baales, e hizo postes para adorar a Aserá. Se inclinó ante el sol, la luna y las estrellas, y los adoró.

fr.L: Et il rebâtit les hauts lieux qu’Ézéchias son père avait démolis, et il éleva des autels aux Baals, et fit des poteaux d’Ashéra, et il se prosterna devant toute l’armée des cieux et la servit.
fr.B: Il rebâtit les hauts lieux que son père Ézéchias avait démolis. Il éleva des autels aux Baals et fit des poteaux d’Ashéra. Il se prosterna devant toute l’armée des cieux et la servit.
fr.R: Il a reconstruit les sanctuaires sur les collines que son père Ézéchias avait démolis. Il a dressé des autels pour adorer les Baals, et il a fait des poteaux sacrés pour adorer la déesse Ashéra. Il s’est mis à genoux devant le soleil, la lune et les étoiles, et il les a adorés.

sw.L: Naye akajenga tena mahali pa juu ambapo Hezekia baba yake alipabomoa, akasimamisha madhabahu kwa ajili ya Mabaali, akafanya miti ya Ashera, akalisujudia jeshi lote la mbinguni, akalitumikia.
sw.B: Alijenga upya mahali pa juu ambapo baba yake Hezekia alipabomoa. Akasimamisha madhabahu kwa ajili ya Mabaali, akafanya miti ya Ashera. Akalisujudia jeshi lote la mbinguni na kulitumikia.
sw.R: Alijenga tena patakatifu pa kilimani ambapo baba yake Hezekia alipabomoa. Alijenga madhabahu za kuyaabudu Mabaali, akatengeneza miti iliyotumiwa kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera. Aliyasujudia jua, mwezi na nyota, akaviabudu.

vi.L: Vua lại xây các nơi cao mà Ê-xê-chia cha vua đã phá đổ, dựng các bàn thờ cho các thần Ba-anh và làm các trụ A-sê-ra; vua cúi lạy cả cơ binh trên trời và phục vụ chúng.
vi.B: Vua xây lại các nơi cao mà Ê-xê-chia cha vua đã phá đổ. Vua dựng các bàn thờ cho các thần Ba-anh và làm các trụ A-sê-ra. Vua cúi lạy cả cơ binh trên trời và phục vụ chúng.
vi.R: Vua xây lại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao mà Ê-xê-chia cha vua đã phá bỏ. Vua dựng các bàn thờ để thờ các thần Ba-anh, và làm các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra. Vua cúi lạy mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao, và thờ phượng chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 아버지 히스기야가 헐어 버린 산당들을 다시 짓고, 바알들을 위하여 제단들을 세우고, 아세라 목상들을 만들었다. 그리고 그가 하늘의 모든 군대에게 절하고 그것들을 섬겼다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지 히스기야가 헐어 버린 산당들을 다시 세웠다. 그는 바알들의 제단들을 세우고 아세라 목상들을 만들었다. 그는 하늘의 모든 별에게 절하고 그것들을 섬겼다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지 히스기야가 헐어 버린 산꼭대기 제단들을 다시 지었다. 그는 바알들을 섬기는 제단들을 세우고, 아세라를 섬기는 데 쓰는 목상들을 만들었다. 그는 해와 달과 별들에게 절하고 그것들을 섬겼다.

pt.L: E voltou a edificar os altos que Ezequias, o seu pai, tinha derrubado, e levantou altares para os baalins, e fez postes de Aserá, e se prostrou diante de todo o exército dos céus e o serviu.
pt.B: Ele reconstruiu os altos que o seu pai Ezequias tinha derrubado. Levantou altares para os baalins e fez postes de Aserá. Prostrou-se diante de todo o exército dos céus e o serviu.
pt.R: Ele construiu de novo os santuários no alto dos morros que o seu pai Ezequias tinha derrubado. Levantou altares para adorar os baalins e fez postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá. Ele se curvou diante do sol, da lua e das estrelas e os adorou.

decisions.choice: differences from 2 Kings 21:3: "pulled down", the Baals and Asherahs in the plural, no mention of Ahab
decisions.reason: Kings says Hezekiah had "destroyed" the high places; Chronicles uses a verb for pulling down or breaking down, as in its account of Hezekiah's reform (31:1). Kings has "Baal" and "an Asherah"; Chronicles has the plurals, "the Baals" and "Asherahs", as it does for Ahaz (28:2) and for the reforms (34:4). Chronicles leaves out the comparison with "Ahab king of Israel".

decisions.choice: he returned and built: he rebuilt
decisions.reason: "Returned and built" is a Hebrew way of saying "built again". Manasseh undid his father's reform, in which Hezekiah had pulled down the high places and altars (31:1; 32:12).

decisions.choice: the Baals and Asherahs: the gods and goddess of Canaan
decisions.reason: Baal was the chief god of the Canaanites, worshiped in many local forms, and the plural "the Baals" covers them all. Asherah was a Canaanite goddess, and her symbol was a wooden pole or tree set up beside an altar.

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens: the sun, moon and stars worshiped as gods
decisions.reason: The "host" or army of the heavens is the sun, moon and stars (Deuteronomy 4:19). Israel was forbidden to bow down to them (Deuteronomy 17:3), as in 2 Kings 21:3.

decisions.choice: high places, Asherah poles, the host of heaven (Literal, Balanced); hilltop shrines, poles used to worship Asherah, the sun, moon and stars (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these words in Samuel, Kings and Chronicles, as in 2 Kings 21:3. Literal says "pulled down" for the verb Chronicles uses, where 2 Kings 21:3 has "destroyed".

decisions.choice: "lugares altos", "postes de Aserá", "el ejército de los cielos" (L, B); "santuarios sobre las colinas", "postes para adorar a Aserá", "el sol, la luna y las estrellas" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording, as Spanish 2 Kings 21:3, with the plurals and "derribado" the Hebrew of Chronicles has (m1).

decisions.choice: "démolis"; "aux Baals"; "des poteaux d'Ashéra" in the plural
decisions.reason: Chronicles' own verb and plurals where French 2 Kings 21:3 has "détruits" and the singular; the rest of that verse's wording is kept.

decisions.choice: "các thần Ba-anh", "các trụ A-sê-ra" in the plural, without "như A-háp"
decisions.reason: The Kings wording is reused where the Hebrew is the same and changed where Chronicles changes it (m1).

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 21:3 with the plurals "바알들", "아세라 목상들" and without Ahab
decisions.reason: Only what the Hebrew of Chronicles changes is changed (m1).

decisions.choice: derrubado (every level); os baalins; postes de Aserá (L, B), postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá (R); o exército dos céus (L, B), o sol, a lua e as estrelas (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 21:3 in Portuguese, changed where Chronicles changes it (m1): "derrubado" for the verb of pulling down, as Hezekiah's reform is told; the plurals "os baalins", the form 17:3 and Judges 2:11 give them, and "postes de Aserá"; and no mention of Ahab. "O exército dos céus" (L, B) and Readable's sun, moon and stars as 2 Kings 21:3 sets them, with the singular "o serviu" (L, B) for the collective noun.

source.text: וּבָנָ֥ה מִזְבְּח֖וֹת בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם יִֽהְיֶה־שְּׁמִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he built altars in [the] house of Yahweh, of which said Yahweh, In Jerusalem will be my name forever.

en.L: And he built altars in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, of which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said, "In Jerusalem my name will be forever."
en.B: He built altars in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the house about which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said, "My name will be in Jerusalem forever."
en.R: He even built altars inside the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. This was the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken of when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "My name will be in Jerusalem forever."

es.L: Y edificó altares en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, de la cual {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho: «En Jerusalén estará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para siempre».
es.B: Construyó altares en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, la casa de la que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho: «Mi nombre estará en Jerusalén para siempre».
es.R: Hasta construyó altares dentro del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ese era el lugar del que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hablado cuando dijo: «Mi nombre estará en Jerusalén para siempre».

fr.L: Et il bâtit des autels dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit : « À Jérusalem sera {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour toujours. »
fr.B: Il bâtit des autels dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, cette maison dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit : « Mon nom sera à Jérusalem pour toujours. »
fr.R: Il a même construit des autels à l’intérieur du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. C’était l’endroit dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait parlé quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dit : « Mon nom sera à Jérusalem pour toujours. »

sw.L: Naye akajenga madhabahu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema habari zake, "Katika Yerusalemu jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litakuwa milele."
sw.B: Alijenga madhabahu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nyumba ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema habari zake, "Jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litakuwa katika Yerusalemu milele."
sw.R: Hata alijenga madhabahu ndani ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hapo ndipo mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema habari zake aliposema, "Jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litakuwa katika Yerusalemu milele."

vi.L: Vua xây các bàn thờ trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán: "Danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở tại Giê-ru-sa-lem đời đời."
vi.B: Vua xây các bàn thờ trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là nhà mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán: "Danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở tại Giê-ru-sa-lem đời đời."
vi.R: Vua còn xây các bàn thờ ngay trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Đây là nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nói đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: "Danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở tại Giê-ru-sa-lem đời đời."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 제단들을 쌓았다. 그 집에 대하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 "예루살렘에 내 이름이 영원히 있을 것이다" 하고 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 제단들을 쌓았다. 그 집은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 "내 이름이 예루살렘에 영원히 있을 것이다" 하고 말씀하신 곳이었다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 안에도 제단들을 쌓았다. 그곳은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 "내 이름이 예루살렘에 영원히 있을 것이다" 하고 말씀하신 곳이었다.

pt.L: E edificou altares na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, da qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito: "Em Jerusalém estará o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome para sempre."
pt.B: Ele construiu altares na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a casa da qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito: "O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome estará em Jerusalém para sempre."
pt.R: Ele chegou a construir altares dentro do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Era desse lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha falado quando disse: "O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome estará em Jerusalém para sempre."

decisions.choice: my name will be in Jerusalem forever: where 2 Kings 21:4 has "I will put my name"
decisions.reason: The verse follows 2 Kings 21:4, but Yahweh's words differ: Kings has "In Jerusalem I will put my name", Chronicles "In Jerusalem my name will be forever". Chronicles uses the same words in Yahweh's answer to Solomon (7:16). Yahweh had chosen Jerusalem as the place for his name (6:6; Deuteronomy 12:5, 11), and Manasseh sets up altars for other gods in the very house that bears it.

decisions.choice: altars: the altars for the host of heaven of verse 5
decisions.reason: Verse 5 says what these altars were for. Verse 4 first names the outrage, that they stood in Yahweh's own house.

decisions.choice: the house about which (Balanced); This was the place ... spoken of (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 21:4: Balanced repeats "the house" so that "about which" plainly refers to the temple, and Readable makes the clause a sentence of its own and adds "even" for the shock of the act. Readable says "temple" for Yahweh's "house".

decisions.choice: "Danh Ta" with a deity_pronoun span, though the English has none here
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "ta" for God is a free pronoun, so it takes the span wherever God speaks of himself, as the Kings drafts do.

decisions.choice: estará o meu nome para sempre (L); O meu nome estará em Jerusalém para sempre (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 21:4 except for the LORD's words, which Chronicles gives as in 7:16 (m1): "o meu nome estará", the verb "estar" of 7:16 in Portuguese, not Kings' "porei". "Meu" takes the deity_pronoun span, as in verse 7 and 2 Kings 21:4, though the English has none here.

source.text: וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְכָל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בִּשְׁתֵּ֖י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he built altars to all [the] host of the heavens in [the] two courts of [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And he built altars to all the host of the heavens in the two courts of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He built altars to all the host of heaven in the two courtyards of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: In both courtyards of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, he built altars to worship the sun, moon and stars.

es.L: Y edificó altares a todo el ejército de los cielos en los dos atrios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Construyó altares a todo el ejército de los cielos en los dos atrios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: En los dos atrios del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} construyó altares para adorar al sol, la luna y las estrellas.

fr.L: Et il bâtit des autels à toute l’armée des cieux dans les deux cours de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il bâtit des autels à toute l’armée des cieux dans les deux cours de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Dans les deux cours du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, il a construit des autels pour adorer le soleil, la lune et les étoiles.

sw.L: Naye akalijengea jeshi lote la mbinguni madhabahu katika nyua mbili za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Alilijengea jeshi lote la mbinguni madhabahu katika nyua mbili za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Katika nyua zote mbili za hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alijenga madhabahu za kuabudu jua, mwezi na nyota.

vi.L: Vua xây các bàn thờ cho cả cơ binh trên trời trong hai sân của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vua xây các bàn thờ cho cả cơ binh trên trời trong hai sân của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Trong cả hai sân của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vua xây các bàn thờ để thờ mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 두 뜰에 하늘의 모든 군대를 위한 제단들을 쌓았다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 두 뜰에 하늘의 모든 별을 섬기는 제단들을 쌓았다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전의 두 뜰에 해와 달과 별들을 섬기는 제단들을 쌓았다.

pt.L: E edificou altares a todo o exército dos céus nos dois pátios da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Construiu altares a todo o exército dos céus nos dois pátios da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Nos dois pátios do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, ele construiu altares para adorar o sol, a lua e as estrelas.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 21:5
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 2 Kings 21:5 and is worded as there.

decisions.choice: the two courts of the house of Yahweh: the inner and the outer court
decisions.reason: Solomon's temple had a court for the priests, where the altar of burnt offering stood, and a great outer court (4:9). Manasseh filled both with altars to the stars.

decisions.choice: the sun, moon and stars
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 21:5
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew as 2 Kings 21:5 (m1), and the same Portuguese at each level.

records.literal_gloss: And he made pass his sons through the fire in [the] valley of Ben-hinnom, and he practiced soothsaying and interpreted omens and practiced sorcery, and he dealt with [a] medium and [a] spiritist; he increased to do the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, to provoke him.

en.L: And he made his sons pass through the fire in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, and he practiced soothsaying and interpreted omens and practiced sorcery, and he dealt with a medium and a spiritist. He did much evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, provoking [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] to anger.
en.B: He made his sons pass through the fire in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, practiced fortune-telling, read omens and practiced sorcery, and consulted a medium and a spiritist. He did much evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, provoking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger.
en.R: He burned his own sons in the fire as sacrifices in the Valley of Ben-hinnom. He told fortunes, read signs to know the future and practiced witchcraft, and he asked mediums and spiritists to get messages from spirits. He did many things that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said were evil, and this made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} angry.

es.L: E hizo pasar a sus hijos por el fuego en el valle de Ben-hinom, y practicó la adivinación, y la interpretación de agüeros, y la hechicería, y trató con médium y espiritista. Multiplicó el hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para provocar[{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] a ira.
es.B: Hizo pasar a sus hijos por el fuego en el valle de Ben-hinom, practicó la adivinación, leyó presagios y practicó la hechicería, y consultó a médiums y espiritistas. Hizo mucho mal a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, provocándo{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} a ira.
es.R: Quemó a sus propios hijos en el fuego como sacrificio en el valle de Ben-hinom. Practicó la adivinación, leyó señales para conocer el futuro y practicó la brujería, y consultó a médiums y espiritistas para recibir mensajes de los espíritus. Hizo muchas cosas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, y esto {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hizo enojar.

fr.L: Et il fit passer ses fils par le feu dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, et il pratiqua la divination, et les présages, et la sorcellerie, et il établit une nécromancienne et un devin. Il multiplia le mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}]irriter.
fr.B: Il fit passer ses fils par le feu dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, pratiqua la divination, chercha des présages et pratiqua la sorcellerie, et il consulta une nécromancienne et un devin. Il fit beaucoup de mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, provoquant ainsi {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.
fr.R: Il a brûlé ses propres fils dans le feu, en sacrifice, dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom. Il a dit l’avenir, il a cherché des signes pour connaître l’avenir et il a pratiqué la magie. Il a demandé à des gens qui interrogent les morts et à des devins de lui transmettre des messages des esprits. Il a fait beaucoup de choses que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvaises, et cela {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a mis en colère.

sw.L: Naye akawapitisha wanawe motoni katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu, akapiga bao, akatazama ishara, akatumia uchawi, akashughulika na mwenye pepo wa mizimu na mpiga ramli. Akazidi kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili [kumkasirisha].
sw.B: Aliwapitisha wanawe motoni katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu, akapiga bao, akatazama ishara, akatumia uchawi, akawaendea wanaowaita wafu na wapiga ramli. Alizidi kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akamkasirisha.
sw.R: Aliwachoma wanawe mwenyewe motoni kuwa dhabihu katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu. Alibashiri, akatazama ishara ili kujua yatakayotokea, akafanya uchawi, akawaendea wanaowaita wafu na wapiga ramli ili kupata ujumbe kutoka kwa mizimu. Alifanya mambo mengi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaona kuwa mabaya, na hayo yakamkasirisha.

vi.L: Vua cho các con trai mình đi qua lửa trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, làm phép bói, xem điềm, làm phù phép, giao thiệp với đồng bóng và thầy đồng. Vua làm nhiều điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chọc giận [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}].
vi.B: Vua cho các con trai mình đi qua lửa trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, làm bói toán, xem điềm, làm phù phép, và cầu hỏi đồng bóng, thầy đồng. Vua làm nhiều điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vua thiêu chính các con trai mình trong lửa để làm sinh tế tại thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm. Vua bói toán, xem điềm để biết tương lai, làm phép phù thủy, và nhờ đồng bóng, thầy đồng để nhận lời từ các vong linh. Vua làm nhiều điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, và điều này khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 벤힌놈 골짜기에서 자기 아들들을 불 가운데로 지나가게 하고, 점을 치고 징조를 풀고 마술을 행하고, 혼백을 불러내는 자와 영매와 어울렸다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 많이 하여 [그분을] 노엽게 했다.
ko.B: 그는 벤힌놈 골짜기에서 자기 아들들을 불 가운데로 지나가게 하고, 점을 치고 징조를 살피고 마술을 행하며, 혼백을 불러내는 자와 영매에게 물었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 많이 하여 그분을 노엽게 했다.
ko.R: 그는 벤힌놈 골짜기에서 자기 아들들을 불에 태워 제물로 바쳤다. 그는 점을 치고 앞날을 알려고 징조를 살피고 마술을 부렸다. 그는 죽은 사람의 영에게서 말을 들으려고 혼백을 불러내는 사람들과 영매들에게 물었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 많이 했고, 그래서 그분을 화나시게 했다.

pt.L: E fez os seus filhos passarem pelo fogo no vale de Ben-Hinom, e praticou agouros, e interpretou presságios, e praticou feitiçaria, e consultou um médium e um espírita. Fez muito mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, provocando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} à ira.
pt.B: Ele fez os seus filhos passarem pelo fogo no vale de Ben-Hinom, leu a sorte, interpretou presságios, praticou feitiçaria e consultou um médium e um espírita. Fez muito mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, provocando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} à ira.
pt.R: Ele chegou a queimar os seus próprios filhos no fogo como sacrifício, no vale de Ben-Hinom. Lia a sorte, interpretava sinais para saber o futuro e praticava feitiçaria, e pedia a médiuns e espíritas que trouxessem mensagens dos espíritos. Fez muitas coisas que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava más, e isso {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deixou irado.

decisions.choice: differences from 2 Kings 21:6: "his sons", the place named, sorcery added
decisions.reason: Kings says Manasseh made "his son" pass through the fire; Chronicles has "his sons" and names the place, the Valley of Ben-hinnom, as it does for Ahaz (28:3). Chronicles adds "practiced sorcery", one more of the practices Deuteronomy 18:10 forbids. It also has "a spiritist" where Kings has "spiritists".

decisions.choice: made his sons pass through the fire in the Valley of Ben-hinnom: offered his sons as burnt sacrifices
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 18:10 forbids this rite first in its list, and 12:31 shows that it meant burning children to a god. The Valley of Ben-hinnom lay south of Jerusalem; Topheth, the place of burning, was there (2 Kings 23:10; Jeremiah 7:31).

decisions.choice: soothsaying, omens, sorcery, a medium and a spiritist: the practices Deuteronomy 18:10-11 forbids
decisions.reason: The words are those of Deuteronomy 18:10-11. The first may be telling fortunes by reading the clouds; the second is reading omens (Genesis 44:5); the third is working spells or magic (Exodus 22:17). The medium and the spiritist are people who claimed to call up the spirits of the dead or to gain hidden knowledge from them (Leviticus 19:31; 1 Samuel 28:7).

decisions.choice: he did much evil, to provoke: the language of Deuteronomy's warnings
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 21:6. Deuteronomy 4:25 and 31:29 warn that Israel would do evil in Yahweh's eyes and provoke him to anger, and that exile would follow.

decisions.choice: soothsaying, interpreted omens, practiced sorcery (Literal); fortune-telling, read omens, practiced sorcery (Balanced); told fortunes, read signs to know the future, practiced witchcraft (Readable)
decisions.reason: The words used for these practices in Deuteronomy 18:10-11 and 2 Kings 21:6 at each level. Readable says "burned ... as sacrifices" for "made pass through the fire", as there, and keeps the plural "mediums and spiritists" of 2 Kings 21:6 because it speaks of the practice in general.

decisions.choice: him
decisions.reason: The verb "provoke to anger" has no object in Hebrew; the object is Yahweh. Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: "la adivinación, la interpretación de agüeros, la hechicería" (L); "la adivinación, presagios, la hechicería" (B); "brujería" (R)
decisions.reason: The practices keep the Spanish of 2 Kings 21:6 at each level, with sorcery added as the Hebrew of Chronicles has it (m1).

decisions.choice: "divination, présages, sorcellerie, nécromancienne, devin" (Literal, Balanced); "gens qui interrogent les morts", "devins" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The words French 2 Kings 21:6 uses for the practices of Deuteronomy 18:10-11, with the sorcery Chronicles adds.

decisions.choice: the practices worded as 2 Kings 21:6, with "các con trai" and "phù phép" added
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds his sons in the plural, the place and sorcery (m1); the rest keeps the Kings words.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 21:6 with "아들들", the valley named and "마술을 행하다" added
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds these to the Kings verse (m1); "노엽게 하다" (Literal, Balanced) and "화나게 하다" (Readable) keep the 1 Kings wording for provoking to anger.

decisions.choice: fez os seus filhos passarem pelo fogo (L, B), queimar os seus próprios filhos (R); o vale de Ben-Hinom; praticou feitiçaria
alternatives: fez o seu filho passar (as 2 Kings 21:6)

Chronicles has the singular "um médium e um espírita" at Literal and Balanced, as the English; Readable keeps the plural of Kings, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: And he set [the] image of the idol that he had made in [the] house of God, of which said God to David and to Solomon his son, In the house the this and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen from all [the] tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

en.L: And he set the carved image of the idol that he had made in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, "In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel, I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name forever.
en.B: He placed the carved idol he had made in the house of God, about which God had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this house, and in Jerusalem, the city I chose from among all the tribes of Israel, I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name forever.
en.R: He made a carved idol and set it up in God's temple. This was the temple God had spoken about to David and his son Solomon. He had said, "I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name in this temple and in Jerusalem forever. I chose Jerusalem out of all the tribes of Israel.

es.L: Y puso la imagen tallada del ídolo que había hecho en la casa de Dios, de la cual Dios había dicho a David y a Salomón su hijo: «En esta casa y en Jerusalén, que he escogido de entre todas las tribus de Israel, pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para siempre;
es.B: Colocó el ídolo tallado que había hecho en la casa de Dios, de la que Dios había dicho a David y a su hijo Salomón: «En esta casa, y en Jerusalén, la ciudad que escogí de entre todas las tribus de Israel, pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para siempre;
es.R: Hizo un ídolo tallado y lo puso en el templo de Dios. Ese era el templo del que Dios había hablado a David y a su hijo Salomón. Les había dicho: «Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre en este templo y en Jerusalén para siempre. Escogí a Jerusalén de entre todas las tribus de Israel.

fr.L: Et il plaça l’image sculptée de l’idole qu’il avait faite dans la maison de Dieu, dont Dieu avait dit à David et à Salomon son fils : « Dans cette maison et à Jérusalem, que j’ai choisie parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël, je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour toujours ;
fr.B: Il plaça l’idole sculptée qu’il avait faite dans la maison de Dieu, dont Dieu avait dit à David et à son fils Salomon : « Dans cette maison, et à Jérusalem, la ville que j’ai choisie parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël, je placerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour toujours.
fr.R: Il a fabriqué une idole sculptée et il l’a installée dans le temple de Dieu. C’était le temple dont Dieu avait parlé à David et à son fils Salomon. Il avait dit : « Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom dans ce temple et à Jérusalem pour toujours. J’ai choisi Jérusalem parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël.

sw.L: Naye akaweka sanamu ya kuchonga ya kinyago alichokifanya katika nyumba ya Mungu, ambayo Mungu alikuwa amemwambia Daudi na Sulemani mwanawe habari zake, "Katika nyumba hii na katika Yerusalemu, niliouchagua katika makabila yote ya Israeli, nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} milele.
sw.B: Aliweka sanamu ya kuchonga aliyoifanya ndani ya nyumba ya Mungu, ambayo Mungu alikuwa amemwambia Daudi na mwanawe Sulemani habari zake, "Katika nyumba hii, na katika Yerusalemu, mji niliouchagua katikati ya makabila yote ya Israeli, nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} milele.
sw.R: Alitengeneza sanamu ya kuchonga, akaisimamisha katika hekalu la Mungu. Hilo ndilo hekalu ambalo Mungu alikuwa amemwambia Daudi na mwanawe Sulemani habari zake. Alikuwa amesema, "Nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} katika hekalu hili na katika Yerusalemu milele. Niliuchagua Yerusalemu katika makabila yote ya Israeli.

vi.L: Vua đặt tượng chạm của thần tượng mà vua đã làm trong nhà Đức Chúa Trời, là nơi Đức Chúa Trời đã phán với Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn con trai người: "Trong nhà này và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, thành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn giữa mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến đời đời.
vi.B: Vua đặt tượng thần chạm mà vua đã làm trong nhà Đức Chúa Trời, là nhà mà Đức Chúa Trời đã phán với Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn con trai người: "Trong nhà này và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, thành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn giữa mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến đời đời.
vi.R: Vua làm một tượng thần chạm và đặt nó trong đền thờ Đức Chúa Trời. Đây là đền thờ mà Đức Chúa Trời đã nói đến với Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn con trai người. Ngài đã phán: "Ta sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong đền thờ này và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem đến đời đời. Ta đã chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem giữa mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 자기가 만든 우상의 새긴 상을 하나님의 집에 세웠다. 그 집에 대하여 하나님께서 다윗과 그의 아들 솔로몬에게 말씀하셨다. "이 집과, 내가 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 택한 예루살렘에 내가 내 이름을 영원히 두겠다.
ko.B: 그는 자기가 만든 우상을 새겨 하나님의 집에 세웠다. 그 집은 하나님께서 다윗과 그의 아들 솔로몬에게 이렇게 말씀하신 곳이었다. "이 집과, 내가 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 택한 성 예루살렘에 내가 내 이름을 영원히 두겠다.
ko.R: 그는 우상을 새겨 만들어서 하나님의 성전 안에 세웠다. 그 성전은 하나님께서 다윗과 그의 아들 솔로몬에게 말씀하신 바로 그곳이었다. 하나님께서는 이렇게 말씀하셨다. "내가 이 성전과 예루살렘에 내 이름을 영원히 두겠다. 나는 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 예루살렘을 택했다.

pt.L: E pôs a imagem esculpida do ídolo que tinha feito na casa de Deus, da qual Deus tinha dito a Davi e a Salomão, o seu filho: "Nesta casa e em Jerusalém, que escolhi dentre todas as tribos de Israel, porei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome para sempre.
pt.B: Ele colocou o ídolo esculpido que tinha feito na casa de Deus, da qual Deus tinha dito a Davi e ao seu filho Salomão: "Nesta casa e em Jerusalém, a cidade que escolhi dentre todas as tribos de Israel, porei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome para sempre.
pt.R: Ele fez um ídolo esculpido e o colocou no templo de Deus. Era desse templo que Deus tinha falado a Davi e ao seu filho Salomão. Ele tinha dito: "Vou pôr o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome neste templo e em Jerusalém para sempre. Escolhi Jerusalém dentre todas as tribos de Israel.

decisions.choice: differences from 2 Kings 21:7: "the idol" for "the Asherah", and "God" for "Yahweh"
decisions.reason: Kings speaks of "the carved image of the Asherah"; Chronicles has "the carved image of the idol", without naming the goddess. Kings says "the house of which Yahweh had said"; Chronicles has "the house of God, of which God had said". The rest of the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: the carved image of the idol: a carved statue of a god
decisions.reason: The second word means a statue or figure. Deuteronomy 4:16 forbids making one, and Ezekiel 8:3, 5 sees an idol of this kind at the temple's north gate. Manasseh will remove it from the temple after he humbles himself (verse 15).

decisions.choice: in this house and in Jerusalem ... I will put my name forever: Yahweh's promise to David and Solomon
decisions.reason: The words recall what Yahweh said of the temple and of Jerusalem when Solomon dedicated it (6:5-6; 7:12, 16). The promise was given with a condition (7:17-22), and verse 8 recalls it. The idol stands where Yahweh's name was to stand forever.

decisions.choice: forever: the quotation runs on into verse 8
decisions.reason: The sentence goes on into verse 8, which adds the second half of Yahweh's word: the promise that Israel would stay in the land, and its condition.

decisions.choice: the carved image of the idol (Literal); the carved idol (Balanced); a carved idol (Readable)
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew nouns name one object, so Balanced and Readable join them. Readable splits Yahweh's words into two sentences and says "temple" for God's "house", as in 2 Kings 21:7.

decisions.choice: "tượng chạm của thần tượng" (L); "tượng thần chạm" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "the idol" where Kings names Asherah (m1); the rest of the Kings sentence is reused.

decisions.choice: a imagem esculpida do ídolo (L), o ídolo esculpido (B), um ídolo esculpido (R); Deus (no divine_name span)
alternatives: a imagem esculpida de Aserá (as 2 Kings 21:7)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 21:7 in Portuguese, changed only where Chronicles changes it (m1): "do ídolo" for Kings' "de Aserá", with the two nouns joined at Balanced and Readable as the English joins them, and "Deus" for Kings' "SENHOR", so there is no divine_name span. The quotation runs on into verse 8 (m4).

records.literal_gloss: and not I will add to remove [the] foot of Israel from upon the ground which I appointed for your fathers, only if they will keep to do all that I commanded them, as to all the law and the statutes and the judgments by [the] hand of Moses.

en.L: And I will not again remove the foot of Israel from the land that I appointed for your fathers, if only they are careful to do all that I have commanded them, all the law and the statutes and the judgments by the hand of Moses."
en.B: And I will not again make the feet of Israel leave the land I assigned to your ancestors, if only they will be careful to do all that I have commanded them, the whole law, the statutes and the rulings given through Moses."
en.R: I will not make the people of Israel leave the land I set aside for your ancestors again. But they must be careful to obey everything I have commanded them. They must obey the whole law, all the laws and rules I gave them through Moses."

es.L: y no volveré a quitar el pie de Israel de sobre la tierra que asigné a sus padres, con tal que cuiden de hacer todo lo que les he mandado, toda la ley, y los estatutos, y los decretos [dados] por mano de Moisés».
es.B: y no volveré a hacer que los pies de Israel salgan de la tierra que asigné a sus antepasados, con tal que cuiden de cumplir todo lo que les he mandado, toda la ley, los estatutos y los decretos dados por medio de Moisés».
es.R: No volveré a hacer que el pueblo de Israel salga de la tierra que aparté para sus antepasados. Pero ellos tienen que cuidar de obedecer todo lo que les he mandado. Tienen que obedecer toda la ley, todas las leyes y normas que les di por medio de Moisés».

fr.L: et je ne ferai plus écarter le pied d’Israël de la terre que j’ai assignée à vos pères, pourvu seulement qu’ils veillent à faire tout ce que je leur ai prescrit, toute la loi, et les prescriptions, et les ordonnances [données] par la main de Moïse. »
fr.B: Je ne ferai plus errer les pas d’Israël loin de la terre que j’ai assignée à vos ancêtres, pourvu qu’ils veillent à mettre en pratique tout ce que je leur ai prescrit, toute la loi, les prescriptions et les ordonnances données par Moïse. »
fr.R: Je ne ferai plus partir le peuple d’Israël loin du pays que j’ai réservé pour vos ancêtres. Mais ils doivent faire attention à obéir à tout ce que je leur ai commandé. Ils doivent obéir à toute la loi, à toutes les lois et à toutes les règles que je leur ai données par Moïse. »

Họ phải vâng giữ cả luật pháp, mọi luật lệ và quy định {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho họ qua Môi-se."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 내가 그들에게 명령한 모든 것, 곧 모세의 손으로 [준] 모든 율법과 규례와 법도를 지켜 행하기만 하면, 내가 너희 조상들에게 정해 준 땅에서 이스라엘의 발을 다시는 옮기지 않겠다."

decisions.choice: differences from 2 Kings 21:8
decisions.reason: Kings says "make the foot of Israel wander"; Chronicles says "remove the foot of Israel". Kings has "the land that I gave to their fathers"; Chronicles has "that I appointed for your fathers". Kings ends "all the law that my servant Moses commanded them"; Chronicles has "all the law and the statutes and the judgments by the hand of Moses". The promise and its condition are the same.

decisions.choice: remove the foot of Israel: drive Israel from its land
decisions.reason: To remove someone's foot from the land is to put them out of it. The promise was that Israel would be settled for good (2 Samuel 7:10; 1 Chronicles 17:9).

decisions.choice: your fathers: Yahweh turns to address the people
decisions.reason: The quotation is addressed to David and Solomon (verse 7), but here "your fathers" speaks to Israel, and the next clause goes back to "they". The change of person reflects a promise meant for the whole people. The Hebrew wording is kept.

decisions.choice: only if they are careful to do: the condition of the promise
decisions.reason: The promise of the land was never without condition (7:19-20; Deuteronomy 28:63-64). The words prepare for verse 10: they paid no attention.

decisions.choice: the law, the statutes and the judgments by the hand of Moses: all Yahweh's instruction given through Moses
decisions.reason: "Law" (torah) means the whole of Yahweh's instruction; "statutes" and "judgments" name its laws and rulings, as in Deuteronomy 4:1, 8. "By the hand of" means through Moses as the go-between.

decisions.choice: make the feet of Israel leave (Balanced); make the people of Israel leave (Readable); assigned / set aside
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the feet but says "make ... leave", since "remove the feet" is not natural English; it says "feet", as English uses the plural for a people, and "ancestors" for "fathers". Readable says "the people of Israel". "Assigned" and "set aside" render "appointed", which differs from "gave" in 2 Kings 21:8.

decisions.choice: statutes, judgments (Literal); statutes, rulings (Balanced); laws, rules (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these words in the books from Exodus on.

decisions.choice: "los estatutos, y los decretos" (L, B); "las leyes y normas" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for the law's words, as the 2 Kings note settles "estatutos" at Literal and Balanced and plainer words at Readable. Spanish "sus padres" keeps the third person through the promise.

decisions.choice: "luật lệ" and "mạng lệnh" (L, B); "luật lệ" and "quy định" (R)
decisions.reason: The 2 Kings drafts' law words, one per Hebrew term.

decisions.choice: "율법과 규례와 법도" (Literal, Balanced), "율법과 규칙과 명령" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The law words set in the 2 Kings 13-25 drafts; "너희 조상들" keeps the change of person (m3).

decisions.choice: remover o pé (L), os pés ... deixem (B), sair (R); designei para os pais de vocês (L), antepassados de vocês (B, R); pela mão de Moisés (L), por meio de Moisés (B, R)
alternatives: fazer o pé de Israel vaguear (as 2 Kings 21:8)
decisions.reason: Chronicles changes the wording of 2 Kings 21:8 (m1), and Portuguese follows each change: "remover" for Kings' "vaguear", "designei" for "dei", and "vocês" for "seus", since the LORD turns here to address the people (m3), a change of person Portuguese keeps. "Pela mão de" (L) and "por meio de" (B, R) as 2 Kings 21:10 sets them.

decisions.choice: a Lei, os estatutos e as ordenanças (L, B); a Lei, as leis e regras (R)
decisions.reason: The three words for God's instruction through Moses (m5) take the Old Testament terms' "estatuto" and "ordenança"; "a Lei" has its capital as the Law of Moses, and Readable says "leis e regras" as the English says "laws and rules".

source.text: וַיֶּ֣תַע מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת רָ֔ע מִן־הַ֨גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הִשְׁמִ֣יד יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And led astray Manasseh Judah and [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem to do evil more than the nations which destroyed Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And Manasseh led Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem astray to do evil more than the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had destroyed before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: Manasseh led Judah and the people of Jerusalem astray, so that they did more evil than the nations {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had destroyed ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: Manasseh led the people of Judah and Jerusalem to do wrong. They did even more evil things than the nations {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had wiped out to make room for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Y Manasés extravió a Judá y a los habitantes de Jerusalén para que hicieran lo malo más que las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había destruido delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Manasés extravió a Judá y a los habitantes de Jerusalén, de modo que hicieron más mal que las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había destruido delante de los israelitas.
es.R: Manasés llevó a la gente de Judá y de Jerusalén a hacer el mal. Hicieron cosas aún peores que las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había destruido para dar lugar a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et Manassé égara Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem, pour faire le mal plus que les nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait détruites devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Manassé égara Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem, si bien qu’ils firent plus de mal que les nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait détruites devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Manassé a entraîné les gens de Juda et de Jérusalem à mal agir. Ils ont fait des choses encore plus mauvaises que les peuples que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait détruits pour faire de la place aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Lakini Manase akawapotosha Yuda na wakaaji wa Yerusalemu kufanya maovu kuliko mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaangamiza mbele ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Manase aliwapotosha Yuda na watu wa Yerusalemu, hata wakafanya maovu zaidi kuliko mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaangamiza mbele ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Manase aliwaongoza watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu kufanya mabaya. Walifanya mambo maovu kuliko hata mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaangamiza ili kuwapa Waisraeli nafasi.

vi.L: Ma-na-se dẫn Giu-đa và dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem lầm lạc, làm điều ác hơn các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã tiêu diệt trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Ma-na-se dẫn Giu-đa và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem lầm lạc, khiến họ làm điều ác còn hơn các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã tiêu diệt trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Ma-na-se dẫn dân Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem làm điều sai trái. Họ làm điều ác còn hơn các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã tiêu diệt để nhường chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 므낫세가 유다와 예루살렘 주민들을 꾀어, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 멸하신 민족들보다 더 악한 일을 하게 했다.
ko.B: 므낫세는 유다와 예루살렘 주민들을 잘못된 길로 이끌어, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 멸하신 민족들보다 더 악한 일을 하게 했다.
ko.R: 므낫세는 유다와 예루살렘 백성이 잘못된 길로 가게 했다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 사람들에게 자리를 마련해 주시려고 멸하신 민족들보다 더 악한 일을 했다.

pt.L: E Manassés desviou Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém, para fazerem o mal mais do que as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha destruído de diante dos filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Manassés desviou Judá e os moradores de Jerusalém, de modo que fizeram mais mal do que as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha destruído diante dos israelitas.
pt.R: Manassés levou o povo de Judá e de Jerusalém a fazer o mal. Eles fizeram coisas ainda piores do que as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha destruído para dar lugar aos israelitas.

decisions.choice: differences from 2 Kings 21:9: "Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem" named; "they did not listen" moved to verse 10
decisions.reason: Kings begins "But they did not listen, and Manasseh led them astray". Chronicles names those he led astray, "Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem", a pair it often uses for the people of the kingdom (20:18; 32:33). The people's refusal to listen comes in verse 10, after Yahweh has spoken.

decisions.choice: led astray: made them wander from the right way
decisions.reason: The verb means to cause someone to go astray, like a lost animal. It is the opposite of keeping to the way Yahweh commanded (verse 8).

decisions.choice: more evil than the nations Yahweh destroyed
decisions.reason: The nations of Canaan were destroyed for their practices (verse 2). Judah now goes beyond them, so it has even less claim to the land than they had.

decisions.choice: the people of Jerusalem; to make room for (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "people" for "inhabitants". Readable spells out what "destroyed before" Israel meant, as in 2 Kings 21:9.

decisions.choice: desviou Judá e os habitantes (L), os moradores (B) de Jerusalém; levou o povo de Judá e de Jerusalém (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 21:9 in Portuguese, without its "Mas eles não ouviram", which Chronicles moves to verse 10, and with the people named, "Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém" (m1). "Moradores" at Balanced, as Kings' Balanced says it for the same word.
