records.literal_gloss: And spoke Yahweh to Manasseh and to his people, and not they paid attention.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they did not pay attention.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they paid no attention.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they would not listen.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló a Manasés y a su pueblo, pero no hicieron caso.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló a Manasés y a su pueblo, pero no prestaron atención.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló a Manasés y a su pueblo, pero no quisieron escuchar.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Manassé et à son peuple, mais ils ne furent pas attentifs.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Manassé et à son peuple, mais ils n’y prêtèrent pas attention.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé à Manassé et à son peuple, mais ils n’ont pas voulu écouter.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema na Manase na watu wake, lakini hawakusikiliza.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema na Manase na watu wake, lakini hawakujali.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema na Manase na watu wake, lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Ma-na-se và dân của vua, nhưng họ không để ý.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Ma-na-se và dân của vua, nhưng họ chẳng lưu tâm.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Ma-na-se và dân của vua, nhưng họ không chịu nghe.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 므낫세와 그의 백성에게 말씀하셨으나, 그들은 귀를 기울이지 않았다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 므낫세와 그의 백성에게 말씀하셨으나, 그들은 귀를 기울이지 않았다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 므낫세와 그의 백성에게 말씀하셨지만, 그들은 들으려 하지 않았다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou a Manassés e ao seu povo, mas eles não deram atenção.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} falou a Manassés e ao seu povo, mas eles não deram atenção.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} falou a Manassés e ao seu povo, mas eles não quiseram ouvir.

decisions.choice: a short summary in place of the prophets' oracle of 2 Kings 21:10-15
decisions.reason: Kings tells how Yahweh spoke "by the hand of his servants the prophets" and gives their long word of judgment on Jerusalem and Judah (2 Kings 21:10-15), and adds Manasseh's shedding of innocent blood (21:16). Chronicles says only that Yahweh spoke to Manasseh and his people and that they paid no attention, and turns at once to what happened to Manasseh himself. Verse 18 says that the words came through seers who spoke in Yahweh's name.

decisions.choice: paid attention: listened closely, took heed
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn the ear and listen with care. The same verb is used of warnings that went unheeded before the exile (Jeremiah 6:10, 17; Zechariah 7:11). It takes up the "they did not listen" of 2 Kings 21:9.

decisions.choice: would not listen
decisions.reason: Readable says the people refused to listen, which is what "did not pay attention" means here.

decisions.choice: não deram atenção (L, B); não quiseram ouvir (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to listen closely and take heed (m2), and "dar atenção" says it at Literal and Balanced, apart from the plain "ouvir" that Kings uses; Readable says the people refused, as the English does.

source.text: וַיָּבֵ֨א יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־שָׂרֵ֤י הַצָּבָא֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיִּלְכְּד֥וּ אֶת־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה בַּחֹחִ֑ים וַיַּֽאַסְרֻ֨הוּ֙ בַּֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם וַיּוֹלִיכֻ֖הוּ בָּבֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought Yahweh upon them the commanders of the army which [belonged] to [the] king of Assyria, and they captured Manasseh with the hooks, and they bound him with the bronze fetters, and they brought him to Babylon.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brought upon them the commanders of the army of the king of Assyria, and they captured Manasseh with hooks and bound him with bronze fetters and brought him to Babylon.
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brought against them the commanders of the army of the king of Assyria, who captured Manasseh with hooks, bound him with bronze chains and took him to Babylon.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent the army commanders of the king of Assyria against them. They captured Manasseh and led him away with hooks. They bound him with bronze chains and took him to Babylon.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} trajo sobre ellos a los jefes del ejército del rey de Asiria, y capturaron a Manasés con garfios, y lo ataron con cadenas de bronce y lo llevaron a Babilonia.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} trajo contra ellos a los jefes del ejército del rey de Asiria, que capturaron a Manasés con garfios, lo ataron con cadenas de bronce y lo llevaron a Babilonia.
es.R: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió contra ellos a los jefes del ejército del rey de Asiria. Ellos capturaron a Manasés y se lo llevaron sujeto con garfios. Lo ataron con cadenas de bronce y lo llevaron a Babilonia.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fit venir contre eux les chefs de l’armée du roi d’Assyrie, et ils prirent Manassé avec des crochets, et le lièrent avec une double chaîne de bronze, et l’emmenèrent à Babylone.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fit venir contre eux les chefs de l’armée du roi d’Assyrie, qui capturèrent Manassé avec des crochets, le lièrent avec des chaînes de bronze et l’emmenèrent à Babylone.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé contre eux les chefs de l’armée du roi d’Assyrie. Ils ont capturé Manassé et l’ont emmené avec des crochets. Ils l’ont attaché avec des chaînes de bronze et ils l’ont emmené à Babylone.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaleta juu yao makamanda wa jeshi la mfalme wa Ashuru, nao wakamkamata Manase kwa kulabu, wakamfunga kwa pingu za shaba, wakampeleka Babeli.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alileta dhidi yao makamanda wa jeshi la mfalme wa Ashuru, waliomkamata Manase kwa kulabu, wakamfunga kwa minyororo ya shaba, wakampeleka Babeli.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwatuma makamanda wa jeshi la mfalme wa Ashuru dhidi yao. Wakamkamata Manase, wakamwongoza kwa kulabu. Wakamfunga kwa minyororo ya shaba, wakampeleka Babeli.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem các tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua A-si-ri đến đánh họ; chúng bắt Ma-na-se bằng móc, xiềng vua bằng xiềng đồng, và giải vua về Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem các tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua A-si-ri đến đánh họ. Chúng bắt Ma-na-se bằng móc, xiềng vua bằng xích đồng và giải vua về Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai các tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua A-si-ri đến đánh họ. Chúng bắt Ma-na-se và dùng móc dẫn vua đi. Chúng xiềng vua bằng xích đồng và giải về Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 앗시리아 왕의 군대 사령관들을 그들에게 오게 하셨다. 그리고 그들이 므낫세를 갈고리로 사로잡고, 놋 사슬로 그를 묶어 바빌론으로 끌고 갔다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 앗시리아 왕의 군대 사령관들이 그들을 치게 하셨다. 그들은 므낫세를 갈고리로 꿰어 사로잡고, 놋 사슬로 묶어 바빌론으로 끌고 갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 앗시리아 왕의 군대 사령관들을 보내셔서 그들을 치게 하셨다. 그들은 므낫세를 사로잡아 갈고리로 꿰어 끌고 갔다. 그들은 그를 놋 사슬로 묶어 바빌론으로 데려갔다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} trouxe sobre eles os comandantes do exército do rei da Assíria, e eles capturaram Manassés com ganchos, e o prenderam com correntes de bronze, e o levaram para a Babilônia.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} trouxe contra eles os comandantes do exército do rei da Assíria, que capturaram Manassés com ganchos, o prenderam com correntes de bronze e o levaram para a Babilônia.
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} mandou contra eles os comandantes do exército do rei da Assíria. Eles capturaram Manassés e o levaram preso por ganchos. Eles o prenderam com correntes de bronze e o levaram para a Babilônia.

decisions.choice: the king of Assyria and Babylon: Manasseh was Assyria's subject king
decisions.reason: Verses 11-17 have no parallel in Kings. In Manasseh's day Assyria ruled the whole region, and Babylon was under the Assyrian king. Assyrian records of the period name "Manasseh king of Judah" among the kings who paid tribute and supplied materials for the Assyrian king's building work. The text does not say which king of Assyria this was or when it happened.

decisions.choice: with hooks: led away like a captured animal
alternatives: among the thorns (where he was hiding)
decisions.reason: The word means thorns or hooks (Job 40:26, of a hook put through a beast's jaw). Assyrian pictures show captives led by a hook or ring through the nose or lip, and Ezekiel 19:4, 9 pictures kings of Judah led away with hooks to Egypt and to Babylon. The words could also mean that he was caught "among the thorns", where he had hidden (1 Samuel 13:6).

decisions.choice: bronze fetters: a pair of bronze chains
decisions.reason: The word is dual, a pair of shackles for the hands or feet. Samson (Judges 16:21) and Zedekiah (2 Kings 25:7) were bound the same way as prisoners.

decisions.choice: Yahweh brought upon them: the capture is Yahweh's doing
decisions.reason: The people would not listen to Yahweh's word (verse 10), so he brings the Assyrian commanders upon them. Chronicles often tells how a king who forsakes Yahweh is handed over to his enemies (12:5; 24:24; 28:5).

decisions.choice: the commanders of the army (Literal, Balanced); the army commanders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the commander of the army in these books, here in the plural. Literal leaves out the "which [belonged] to" of the Hebrew, which only shows whose army it was.

decisions.choice: led him away with hooks
decisions.reason: Readable says what the hooks were for, following the reading chosen in m2.

decisions.choice: "se lo llevaron sujeto con garfios"
decisions.reason: Readable says what the hooks were for, following the reading of the meaning decision (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "군대 사령관들" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the commander of the army, here in the plural.

decisions.choice: com ganchos (every level); o levaram preso por ganchos (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the hook put through a captive's nose or lip (m2), and "ganchos" is the plain Portuguese word for it; "anzóis" would be fishhooks, "argolas" only rings. Readable says what the hooks were for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: correntes de bronze
decisions.reason: The pair of fetters (m3) is "correntes de bronze", as 2 Kings 25:7 and Judges 16:21 have them in Portuguese, so the reader sees Manasseh bound as Zedekiah will be.

source.text: וּכְהָצֵ֣ר ל֔וֹ חִלָּ֕ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיִּכָּנַ֣ע מְאֹ֔ד מִלִּפְנֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And when distressing to him, he entreated [the] face of Yahweh his God, and he humbled himself greatly before [the] God of his fathers.

en.L: And when he was in distress, he implored the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, and he humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
en.B: In his distress he sought the favor of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God and humbled himself deeply before the God of his ancestors.
en.R: When Manasseh was in trouble, he begged {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God to be kind to him. He made himself very humble before the God of his ancestors.

es.L: Y cuando estuvo en angustia, imploró el rostro {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, y se humilló grandemente delante del Dios de sus padres.
es.B: En su angustia buscó el favor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios y se humilló profundamente delante del Dios de sus antepasados.
es.R: Cuando Manasés estaba en apuros, le rogó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios que tuviera compasión de él. Se humilló mucho delante del Dios de sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et quand il fut dans la détresse, il implora la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu, et il s’humilia profondément devant le Dieu de ses pères.
fr.B: Dans sa détresse, il chercha à apaiser {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu et s’humilia profondément devant le Dieu de ses ancêtres.
fr.R: Quand Manassé a été dans le malheur, il a supplié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu d’être bon pour lui. Il s’est fait tout petit devant le Dieu de ses ancêtres.

sw.L: Naye alipokuwa katika dhiki, akauomba uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, akajinyenyekeza sana mbele za Mungu wa baba zake.
sw.B: Katika dhiki yake aliutafuta wema wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, akajinyenyekeza sana mbele za Mungu wa babu zake.
sw.R: Manase alipokuwa katika taabu, alimsihi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake amhurumie. Akajinyenyekeza sana mbele za Mungu wa babu zake.

vi.L: Khi gặp hoạn nạn, vua nài xin trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua, và hạ mình rất nhiều trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ vua.
vi.B: Trong cơn hoạn nạn, vua cầu xin ơn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua, và hết sức hạ mình trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên vua.
vi.R: Khi gặp hoạn nạn, Ma-na-se nài xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua, thương xót mình. Vua hết sức hạ mình trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 고난을 당할 때에 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 얼굴에 간구하고, 그의 조상들의 하나님 앞에서 크게 자신을 낮추었다.
ko.B: 그는 고난 가운데서 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 은혜를 구하고, 그의 조상들의 하나님 앞에서 깊이 자신을 낮추었다.
ko.R: 므낫세는 어려움을 당하자, 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 자비를 베풀어 달라고 빌었다. 그는 조상들의 하나님 앞에서 아주 겸손해졌다.

pt.L: E, quando estava em aflição, implorou à face {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, e se humilhou muito diante do Deus dos seus pais.
pt.B: Na sua aflição, ele buscou o favor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, e se humilhou profundamente diante do Deus dos seus antepassados.
pt.R: Quando Manassés estava em dificuldade, ele implorou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, que tivesse bondade dele. Ele se fez muito humilde diante do Deus dos seus antepassados.

decisions.choice: implored the face of Yahweh: sought his favor
decisions.reason: The phrase means to soften someone's face, that is, to seek the favor of someone who is angry, as in Exodus 32:11 and 1 Kings 13:6.

decisions.choice: humbled himself: the turning Yahweh promised to hear
decisions.reason: Yahweh had promised Solomon, "if my people ... humble themselves and pray and seek my face ... I will hear from heaven" (7:14). Manasseh does each part of it: he seeks Yahweh's face, humbles himself and prays (verse 13). Chronicles uses this verb for kings who turn back to Yahweh (12:6-7, 12; 32:26).

decisions.choice: his God, the God of his fathers
decisions.reason: Manasseh had served other gods (verses 3-7), yet in his distress he turns to Yahweh as "his God" and as the God of his ancestors, David and Hezekiah. The words mark his return to the faith he had abandoned.

decisions.choice: implored (Literal); sought the favor of (Balanced); begged ... to be kind (Readable)
decisions.reason: Worded as in Exodus 32:11. Literal says "when he was in distress" for the Hebrew "when it distressed him".

decisions.choice: "imploró el rostro" (L); "buscó el favor" (B); "le rogó ... que tuviera compasión" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the face; Balanced and Readable give its sense (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "얼굴에 간구하고" at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase of seeking someone's face (m1); Balanced and Readable give its sense.

decisions.choice: implorou à face (L); buscou o favor (B); implorou ... que tivesse bondade (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom of softening the face (m1) keeps the Portuguese of Exodus 32:11 at each level, as the English keeps its wording there.

decisions.choice: se humilhou (L, B); se fez muito humilde (R)
decisions.reason: "Humilhar-se" is the verb of the LORD's promise in 7:14 and of Rehoboam in 12:6-7, 12 in Portuguese (m2), so the reader hears that Manasseh does what 7:14 asks; it is kept for the same verb in verses 19 and 23.

source.text: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֗יו וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע תְּחִנָּת֔וֹ וַיְשִׁיבֵ֥הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְמַלְכוּת֑וֹ וַיֵּ֣דַע מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֥וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he prayed to him, and he was entreated by him and heard his supplication and brought him back [to] Jerusalem to his kingdom; and knew Manasseh that Yahweh, he [is] the God.

en.L: And he prayed to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was entreated by him and heard his supplication and brought him back to Jerusalem, to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] God.
en.B: He prayed to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was moved by his prayer. He heard his plea for mercy and brought him back to Jerusalem, to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is God.
en.R: He prayed to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} listened to him. God heard his cry for mercy and brought him back to Jerusalem to rule his kingdom again. Then Manasseh knew that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is the true God.

es.L: Y oró a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se dejó rogar por él, y oyó su súplica, y lo hizo volver a Jerusalén, a su reino. Entonces Manasés supo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] Dios.
es.B: Oró a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se conmovió por su oración. Oyó su súplica y lo hizo volver a Jerusalén, a su reino. Entonces Manasés supo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Dios.
es.R: Oró a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo escuchó. Dios oyó su clamor pidiendo compasión y lo hizo volver a Jerusalén para que reinara otra vez. Entonces Manasés supo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el Dios verdadero.

fr.L: Et il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pria, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se laissa fléchir par lui, et entendit sa supplication, et le ramena à Jérusalem, dans son royaume. Alors Manassé sut que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’[est] {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui [est] Dieu.
fr.B: Il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pria, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se laissa toucher par sa prière. Il entendit sa supplication et le ramena à Jérusalem, dans son royaume. Alors Manassé sut que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est Dieu.
fr.R: Il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a prié, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a écouté. Dieu a entendu sa demande de pitié et l’a ramené à Jérusalem pour qu’il règne de nouveau sur son royaume. Alors Manassé a su que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le vrai Dieu.

sw.L: Akamwomba, naye akakubali maombi yake, akasikia dua yake, akamrudisha Yerusalemu, katika ufalme wake. Ndipo Manase akajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] Mungu.
sw.B: Alimwomba, naye akaguswa na maombi yake. Akasikia dua yake ya rehema, akamrudisha Yerusalemu, katika ufalme wake. Ndipo Manase akajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu.
sw.R: Alimwomba, naye akamsikiliza. Mungu alisikia kilio chake cha rehema, akamrudisha Yerusalemu ili atawale ufalme wake tena. Ndipo Manase akajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu wa kweli.

vi.L: Vua cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhậm lời vua nài xin, nghe lời khẩn cầu của vua, và đem vua trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem, về vương quốc của vua. Bấy giờ Ma-na-se biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Vua cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cảm động trước lời cầu nguyện của vua. Ngài nghe lời khẩn cầu của vua và đem vua trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem, về vương quốc của vua. Bấy giờ Ma-na-se biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Vua cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lắng nghe vua. Đức Chúa Trời nghe lời vua kêu xin thương xót và đem vua trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem để cai trị vương quốc mình một lần nữa. Bấy giờ Ma-na-se biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời thật.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그분께 기도하자, 그분께서 그의 간구를 받아들이시고 그의 애원을 들으셔서, 그를 예루살렘으로, 그의 나라로 돌아오게 하셨다. 그때에 므낫세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분이 하나님이심을 알았다.
ko.B: 그가 기도하자, 주께서 그의 기도에 마음이 움직이셔서 그의 간구를 들으시고, 그를 예루살렘으로, 그의 나라로 돌아오게 하셨다. 그제야 므낫세는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나님이심을 알았다.
ko.R: 그가 기도하자, 하나님께서 그의 기도를 들어주셨다. 하나님께서는 자비를 구하는 그의 부르짖음을 들으시고, 그를 예루살렘으로 데려오셔서 다시 나라를 다스리게 하셨다. 그제야 므낫세는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 참 하나님이심을 알게 되었다.

pt.L: E orou a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se deixou comover por ele, e ouviu a sua súplica, e o trouxe de volta a Jerusalém, ao seu reino. Então Manassés soube que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] Deus.
pt.B: Ele orou a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se comoveu com a sua oração. Ouviu o seu pedido de misericórdia e o trouxe de volta a Jerusalém, ao seu reino. Então Manassés soube que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é Deus.
pt.R: Ele orou a Deus, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o escutou. Deus ouviu o seu pedido de misericórdia e o trouxe de volta a Jerusalém para governar de novo o seu reino. Então Manassés soube que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é o verdadeiro Deus.

decisions.choice: he was entreated by him: God let himself be moved by his prayer
decisions.reason: This form of the verb means to let oneself be moved by a plea and to grant it (1 Chronicles 5:20; 2 Samuel 24:25). The subject is God, to whom Manasseh prayed.

decisions.choice: supplication: a plea for mercy
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to be gracious" and names a prayer asking for grace, as in Solomon's prayer (6:19, 29, 35, 39).

decisions.choice: brought him back to Jerusalem, to his kingdom: the answer to a humbled king
decisions.reason: Solomon had prayed that if Israel were taken captive to a foreign land and turned to Yahweh there with all their heart, he would hear and forgive (6:36-39). Manasseh's story shows that prayer answered in one man: a captive king, taken away for his sin, is brought home when he humbles himself.

decisions.choice: Manasseh knew that Yahweh, he is God: the confession of Israel
decisions.reason: The words are those of Deuteronomy 4:35, 39 and of the people on Mount Carmel (1 Kings 18:39). Manasseh, who had served many gods, now knows by what happened to him that Yahweh alone is God.

decisions.choice: the LORD is God (Balanced); the LORD is the true God (Readable)
decisions.reason: The pronoun "he" repeats the subject for emphasis. Literal keeps it, as in 1 Kings 18:39; Balanced leaves it out, and Readable carries the emphasis with "the true God", as there. Balanced and Readable begin a new sentence after the prayer, and Readable says "God" to make clear who heard.

decisions.choice: to rule his kingdom again
decisions.reason: Readable says what "to his kingdom" means: he was king again.

decisions.choice: "el SEÑOR, él [es] Dios" (L); "es Dios" (B); "es el Dios verdadero" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the repeated pronoun of the confession, as Spanish 1 Kings 18:39 does; Balanced and Readable leave it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "c'[est] lui qui [est] Dieu" (Literal); "est Dieu" (Balanced); "est le vrai Dieu" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the emphatic pronoun, Readable carries the emphasis with "le vrai Dieu", as at 1 Kings 18:39.

decisions.choice: "주, 그분이 하나님이심을" at Literal, keeping the repeated pronoun
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the emphatic "he" of the confession, as in 1 Kings 18:39 (r-en-1); Readable says "참 하나님".

decisions.choice: se deixou comover (L), se comoveu com a sua oração (B), o escutou (R); súplica (L), pedido de misericórdia (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means letting oneself be moved by a plea and granting it (m1), and "deixar-se comover" says that at Literal. The plea for grace (m2) is "súplica", the word of Solomon's prayer in 6:19 and 6:39 in Portuguese, at Literal. Readable says "Deus" for the first "him", where the English keeps a pronoun, so that the reader does not take it for Manasseh.

decisions.choice: o SENHOR, ele [é] Deus (L); o SENHOR é Deus (B); o SENHOR é o verdadeiro Deus (R)
decisions.reason: The confession of 1 Kings 18:39 and Deuteronomy 4:35 (m4): Literal keeps the repeated pronoun, as the English Literal does, and Readable carries its emphasis with "o verdadeiro Deus".

source.text: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֡ן בָּנָ֣ה חוֹמָ֣ה חִֽיצוֹנָ֣ה׀לְעִיר־דָּוִ֡יד מַעְרָבָה֩ לְגִיח֨וֹן בַּנַּ֜חַל וְלָב֨וֹא בְשַׁ֤עַר הַדָּגִים֙ וְסָבַ֣ב לָעֹ֔פֶל וַיַּגְבִּיהֶ֖הָ מְאֹ֑ד וַיָּ֧שֶׂם שָֽׂרֵי־חַ֛יִל בְּכָל־הֶעָרִ֥ים הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת בִּיהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And after thus he built [an] outer wall to [the] city of David, westward to Gihon in the valley, and to [the] entering at [the] gate of the fish, and he went around to the Ophel and made it high very; and he put commanders of [the] force in all the cities the fortified in Judah.

en.L: And after this he built an outer wall for the City of David, west of Gihon in the valley, and as far as the entrance at the Fish Gate, and it went around the Ophel, and he made it very high. And he put commanders of the army in all the fortified cities in Judah.
en.B: After this he built an outer wall for the City of David, west of Gihon in the valley, as far as the entrance at the Fish Gate. He carried it around the Ophel and made it very high. He also stationed army commanders in all the fortified cities of Judah.
en.R: After this, Manasseh built an outer wall for the City of David. It ran west of the Gihon spring in the Kidron Valley as far as the Fish Gate, and went around the hill called Ophel. He made the wall very high. He also put army commanders in all the fortified cities of Judah.

es.L: Y después de esto edificó un muro exterior para la ciudad de David, al occidente de Gihón, en el valle, hasta la entrada de la puerta del Pescado, y rodeó el Ofel, y lo hizo muy alto. Y puso jefes del ejército en todas las ciudades fortificadas de Judá.
es.B: Después de esto construyó un muro exterior para la ciudad de David, al occidente de Gihón, en el valle, hasta la entrada de la puerta del Pescado. Lo hizo rodear el Ofel y lo levantó muy alto. También puso jefes militares en todas las ciudades fortificadas de Judá.
es.R: Después de esto, Manasés construyó un muro exterior para la ciudad de David. Iba al occidente del manantial de Gihón, en el valle del Cedrón, hasta la puerta del Pescado, y rodeaba la colina llamada Ofel. Hizo el muro muy alto. También puso jefes del ejército en todas las ciudades fortificadas de Judá.

fr.L: Et après cela, il bâtit une muraille extérieure à la cité de David, à l’ouest de Guihôn, dans la vallée, jusqu’à l’entrée de la porte des Poissons, et elle entourait l’Ophel, et il l’éleva très haut. Et il mit des chefs d’armée dans toutes les villes fortifiées de Juda.
fr.B: Après cela, il bâtit une muraille extérieure à la cité de David, à l’ouest de Guihôn, dans la vallée, jusqu’à l’entrée de la porte des Poissons. Il la fit passer autour de l’Ophel et l’éleva très haut. Il plaça aussi des chefs militaires dans toutes les villes fortifiées de Juda.
fr.R: Après cela, Manassé a construit une muraille extérieure pour la cité de David. Elle passait à l’ouest de la source de Guihôn, dans la vallée du Cédron, jusqu’à la porte des Poissons, et elle faisait le tour de la colline appelée l’Ophel. Il a élevé la muraille très haut. Il a aussi mis des chefs militaires dans toutes les villes fortifiées de Juda.

sw.L: Baada ya hayo akajenga ukuta wa nje wa mji wa Daudi, upande wa magharibi wa Gihoni bondeni, hata kufikia maingilio ya Lango la Samaki, ukazunguka Ofeli, akaufanya juu sana. Akaweka makamanda wa jeshi katika miji yote yenye ngome ya Yuda.
sw.B: Baada ya hayo alijenga ukuta wa nje wa mji wa Daudi, upande wa magharibi wa Gihoni bondeni, mpaka maingilio ya Lango la Samaki. Akauzungusha Ofeli, akaujenga juu sana. Pia aliweka makamanda wa jeshi katika miji yote yenye ngome ya Yuda.
sw.R: Baada ya hayo Manase alijenga ukuta wa nje wa mji wa Daudi. Ulipita upande wa magharibi wa chemchemi ya Gihoni katika Bonde la Kidroni mpaka Lango la Samaki, ukazunguka kilima kiitwacho Ofeli. Akaujenga ukuta huo juu sana. Pia aliweka makamanda wa jeshi katika miji yote yenye ngome ya Yuda.

vi.L: Sau việc ấy, vua xây một bức tường bên ngoài cho thành Đa-vít, phía tây Ghi-hôn trong thung lũng, cho đến lối vào Cổng Cá, và bao quanh Ô-phên, và xây rất cao. Vua đặt các tướng chỉ huy quân đội trong mọi thành kiên cố của Giu-đa.
vi.B: Sau đó, vua xây một bức tường bên ngoài cho thành Đa-vít, phía tây Ghi-hôn trong thung lũng, đến tận lối vào Cổng Cá. Vua xây tường bao quanh Ô-phên và xây rất cao. Vua cũng đặt các tướng chỉ huy quân đội trong mọi thành kiên cố của Giu-đa.
vi.R: Sau đó, Ma-na-se xây một bức tường bên ngoài cho thành Đa-vít. Tường chạy về phía tây suối Ghi-hôn trong thung lũng Xết-rôn đến tận Cổng Cá, và vòng quanh đồi Ô-phên. Vua xây tường ấy rất cao. Vua cũng đặt các tướng chỉ huy quân đội trong mọi thành kiên cố của Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 그 뒤에 그가 다윗 성 바깥 성벽을 쌓았는데, 골짜기에 있는 기혼 서쪽에서부터 물고기 문 입구까지였고, [그것이] 오벨을 둘러쌌으며, 그가 그것을 매우 높게 했다. 그리고 그가 유다의 모든 요새 성읍에 군대 지휘관들을 두었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 그는 다윗 성 바깥에 성벽을 쌓았다. 그 성벽은 골짜기에 있는 기혼 서쪽에서 물고기 문 입구까지 이어졌다. 그는 그 성벽으로 오벨을 둘러싸고 아주 높이 쌓았다. 그는 또 유다의 모든 요새 성읍에 군대 지휘관들을 두었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 므낫세는 다윗 성 바깥에 성벽을 하나 더 쌓았다. 그 성벽은 기드론 골짜기에 있는 기혼 샘 서쪽에서 물고기 문까지 이어졌고, 오벨이라는 언덕을 둘러쌌다. 그는 그 성벽을 아주 높이 쌓았다. 그는 또 유다의 모든 요새 성읍에 군대 지휘관들을 두었다.

pt.L: E depois disso ele construiu um muro externo para a Cidade de Davi, a oeste de Giom, no vale, até a entrada da Porta dos Peixes, e ele rodeou o Ofel, e o fez muito alto. E pôs comandantes do exército em todas as cidades fortificadas em Judá.
pt.B: Depois disso, ele construiu um muro externo para a Cidade de Davi, a oeste de Giom, no vale, até a entrada da Porta dos Peixes. Ele o fez rodear o Ofel e o fez muito alto. Também pôs comandantes do exército em todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá.
pt.R: Depois disso, Manassés construiu um muro externo para a Cidade de Davi. O muro passava a oeste da fonte de Giom, no vale do Cedrom, e ia até a Porta dos Peixes. Depois rodeava a colina chamada Ofel. Ele fez o muro muito alto. Também pôs comandantes do exército em todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá.

decisions.choice: an outer wall, west of Gihon in the valley: a new wall on the east side of the City of David
decisions.reason: Gihon was the spring on the east side of the City of David, in the Kidron Valley (32:30; 1 Kings 1:33). A wall "west of Gihon" ran along the slope above the spring, outside the older wall. Hezekiah had also built an outer wall (32:5).

decisions.choice: the Fish Gate and the Ophel
decisions.reason: The Fish Gate was on the north side of the city (Nehemiah 3:3; Zephaniah 1:10), perhaps named for the fish brought in to sell. The Ophel was the raised ground between the City of David and the temple, which Jotham had also built on (27:3).

decisions.choice: and it went around the Ophel, and he made it very high
decisions.reason: The first verb may describe the course of the wall ("it went around") or Manasseh's work ("he carried it around"). The sense is the same: the wall enclosed the Ophel.

decisions.choice: after this: building and strength follow his return to Yahweh
decisions.reason: In Chronicles, building cities and walls and stationing troops are signs of Yahweh's blessing on a faithful king (11:5-12; 14:5-6; 26:9; 32:5). Manasseh's building comes "after this", after he humbled himself and was restored.

decisions.choice: commanders of the army (Literal); army commanders (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Sar in a military setting is "commander" at every level. The word with it here means force or army.

decisions.choice: the Gihon spring in the Kidron Valley; the hill called Ophel
decisions.reason: Readable names the spring and the valley and says what the Ophel was (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: "la puerta del Pescado"; "el Ofel"
decisions.reason: The gate's name translated, as the English says "Fish Gate"; Ophel as at 27:3.

decisions.choice: "Guihôn", "la porte des Poissons"
decisions.reason: "Guihôn" as in the terms note; the gate's name translated, as the other gates of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: Giom (L, B), a fonte de Giom (R); a Porta dos Peixes; o Ofel (L, B), a colina chamada Ofel (R); o vale do Cedrom (R)
decisions.reason: "Giom" and Readable's "a fonte de Giom" as 1 Kings 1:33 has them in Portuguese (m1); "Cedrom" as 2 Kings 23:4. The gate takes its plain name, "a Porta dos Peixes", and the hill its usual Brazilian form, "Ofel", with Readable saying what it was, as the English does (m2).

source.text: וַ֠יָּסַר אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֨י הַנֵּכָ֤ר וְאֶת־הַסֶּ֨מֶל֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְכָל־הַֽמִּזְבְּח֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֛ה בְּהַ֥ר בֵּית־יְהוָ֖ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ ח֥וּצָה לָעִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he removed [the] gods of the foreignness and the idol from [the] house of Yahweh, and all the altars which he had built on [the] mountain of [the] house of Yahweh and in Jerusalem, and he threw [them] outside to the city.

en.L: And he removed the foreign gods and the idol from the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and all the altars that he had built on the mountain of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in Jerusalem, and he threw [them] outside the city.
en.B: He removed the foreign gods from the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the idol as well, together with every altar he had built on the temple mount and elsewhere in Jerusalem, and threw them outside the city.
en.R: He took the foreign gods out of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the idol too. He also took away all the altars he had built on the hill where the temple stood and in Jerusalem, and he threw them out of the city.

es.L: Y quitó los dioses extranjeros y el ídolo de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y todos los altares que había edificado en el monte de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en Jerusalén, y [los] arrojó fuera de la ciudad.
es.B: Quitó de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} los dioses extranjeros, y también el ídolo, junto con todos los altares que había construido en el monte del templo y en otras partes de Jerusalén, y los arrojó fuera de la ciudad.
es.R: Sacó del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} los dioses extranjeros, y también el ídolo. Quitó todos los altares que había construido en el monte donde estaba el templo y en Jerusalén, y los tiró fuera de la ciudad.

fr.L: Et il ôta les dieux étrangers et l’idole de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et tous les autels qu’il avait bâtis sur la montagne de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et à Jérusalem, et il [les] jeta hors de la ville.
fr.B: Il retira de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} les dieux étrangers et l’idole, ainsi que tous les autels qu’il avait bâtis sur la colline du temple et ailleurs dans Jérusalem, et il les jeta hors de la ville.
fr.R: Il a sorti du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} les dieux étrangers et aussi l’idole. Il a aussi enlevé tous les autels qu’il avait construits sur la colline du temple et dans Jérusalem, et il les a jetés hors de la ville.

sw.L: Akaiondoa miungu ya kigeni na kinyago kutoka nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na madhabahu zote alizozijenga juu ya mlima wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika Yerusalemu, akazitupa nje ya mji.
sw.B: Aliiondoa miungu ya kigeni katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, pamoja na kinyago, na kila madhabahu aliyoijenga juu ya mlima wa hekalu na mahali pengine katika Yerusalemu, akazitupa nje ya mji.
sw.R: Aliitoa miungu ya kigeni katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, pamoja na kinyago. Pia aliziondoa madhabahu zote alizozijenga juu ya kilima lilipokuwa hekalu na katika Yerusalemu, akazitupa nje ya mji.

vi.L: Vua dẹp bỏ các thần ngoại bang và thần tượng khỏi nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cùng mọi bàn thờ vua đã xây trên núi của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, rồi ném [chúng] ra ngoài thành.
vi.B: Vua dẹp bỏ các thần ngoại bang khỏi nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cả thần tượng ấy nữa, cùng mọi bàn thờ vua đã xây trên núi đền thờ và những nơi khác trong Giê-ru-sa-lem, rồi ném ra ngoài thành.
vi.R: Vua đem các thần của dân ngoại ra khỏi đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cả thần tượng ấy nữa. Vua cũng dỡ bỏ mọi bàn thờ vua đã xây trên đồi có đền thờ và trong Giê-ru-sa-lem, rồi ném ra khỏi thành.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 이방 신들과 그 우상을 없애고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집이 있는 산과 예루살렘에 자기가 쌓은 모든 제단도 [없애서], 성 밖으로 던져 버렸다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 이방 신들과 그 우상을 없앴다. 성전 산과 예루살렘 곳곳에 자기가 쌓은 모든 제단도 없애서 성 밖으로 던져 버렸다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 다른 나라의 신들과 그 우상을 치웠다. 성전이 서 있는 언덕과 예루살렘에 자기가 쌓았던 모든 제단도 치워서 성 밖으로 내던졌다.

pt.L: E removeu os deuses estrangeiros e o ídolo da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e todos os altares que tinha edificado no monte da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e em Jerusalém, e [os] lançou fora da cidade.
pt.B: Ele removeu da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} os deuses estrangeiros e também o ídolo, junto com todos os altares que tinha construído no monte do templo e em outros lugares de Jerusalém, e os jogou fora da cidade.
pt.R: Ele tirou do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} os deuses estrangeiros e também o ídolo. Também tirou todos os altares que tinha construído no morro onde ficava o templo e em Jerusalém, e os jogou fora da cidade.

decisions.choice: the idol and the altars: undoing what he had done in verses 4-7
decisions.reason: The idol is the one he had set in the house of God (verse 7), and the altars are those of verses 4-5. Kings does not tell of this reform. 2 Kings 23:12 says that Josiah later tore down the altars Manasseh had made in the two courts; Chronicles says only that Manasseh removed them and threw them out, so they may have been set up again under Amon (verse 22).

decisions.choice: the gods of the foreign: gods belonging to other peoples
decisions.reason: The phrase means gods that are foreign to Israel, as in Genesis 35:2, Joshua 24:20 and 1 Samuel 7:3. It sums up the Baals, the Asherahs and the host of heaven (verse 3).

decisions.choice: the mountain of the house of Yahweh: the hill on which the temple stood
decisions.reason: The temple stood on the hill north of the City of David (3:1). The altars there were the ones in the temple courts (verse 5).

decisions.choice: the temple mount (Balanced); the hill where the temple stood (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what "the mountain of the house of the LORD" means (m3). Balanced adds "elsewhere" because the temple mount was itself in Jerusalem. Literal supplies "them" after "threw".

decisions.choice: o monte da casa do SENHOR (L); o monte do templo (B); o morro onde ficava o templo (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what the hill of the LORD's house was (m3), as the English does, and Balanced adds "em outros lugares" because the temple hill was itself in Jerusalem. "O ídolo" is the one of verse 7 (m1), so the same word is kept.
