records.literal_gloss: And he built the altar of Yahweh and sacrificed on it sacrifices of peace offerings and thanksgiving, and he said to Judah to serve Yahweh [the] God of Israel.

en.L: And he rebuilt the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and sacrificed on it sacrifices of peace offerings and thanksgiving, and he told Judah to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.B: He restored the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and offered on it peace offerings and thank offerings, and he commanded Judah to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: He repaired the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and offered peace offerings and offerings to give thanks on it. He told the people of Judah to worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.

es.L: Y reedificó el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y ofreció sobre él sacrificios de paz y de acción de gracias, y dijo a Judá que sirvieran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.B: Restauró el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y ofreció sobre él sacrificios de paz y ofrendas de acción de gracias, y le mandó a Judá que sirviera {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.R: Reparó el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y ofreció sobre él sacrificios de paz y ofrendas para dar gracias. Les dijo a los de Judá que adoraran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.

fr.L: Et il rebâtit l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et y offrit des sacrifices de communion et de reconnaissance, et il dit à Juda de servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Il restaura l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et y offrit des sacrifices de communion et de reconnaissance, et il ordonna à Juda de servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Il a réparé l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et il y a offert des sacrifices de communion et des sacrifices pour remercier Dieu. Il a dit aux gens de Juda d’adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: Akaijenga upya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akatoa juu yake dhabihu za sadaka za amani na za shukrani, akawaambia Yuda wamtumikie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Aliirejesha madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akatoa juu yake sadaka za amani na sadaka za shukrani, akawaamuru Yuda wamtumikie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Aliitengeneza madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akatoa juu yake sadaka za amani na sadaka za kushukuru. Akawaambia watu wa Yuda wamwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Vua xây lại bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và dâng trên đó các sinh tế bình an và tế lễ cảm tạ, rồi bảo Giu-đa phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vua phục hồi bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và dâng trên đó tế lễ bình an và tế lễ cảm tạ, rồi truyền cho Giu-đa phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vua sửa lại bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và dâng trên đó tế lễ bình an và tế lễ cảm tạ. Vua bảo dân Giu-đa thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단을 다시 쌓고, 그 위에 화목제물과 감사제물을 드렸다. 그리고 그가 유다에게 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기라고 말했다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단을 다시 세우고, 그 위에 화목제물과 감사 제물을 드렸다. 그리고 유다에게 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기라고 명령했다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단을 고치고, 그 위에 화목제물과 감사하는 제물을 바쳤다. 그리고 유다 백성에게 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기라고 명령했다.

pt.L: E reconstruiu o altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e sacrificou sobre ele sacrifícios de comunhão e de ação de graças, e disse a Judá que servisse {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.B: Ele restaurou o altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e ofereceu sobre ele sacrifícios de comunhão e sacrifícios de ação de graças, e ordenou a Judá que servisse {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.R: Ele consertou o altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e ofereceu sobre ele sacrifícios de comunhão e sacrifícios para agradecer a Deus. Ele disse ao povo de Judá que adorasse {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.

decisions.choice: built: the reading given in the margin (qere)
alternatives: he set in order the altar
decisions.reason: The letters written in the Hebrew text (ketiv) read "he set up" or "he set in order"; the reading passed down for reading aloud (qere) is "he built", as in the data followed here. Either way the sense is that Manasseh restored Yahweh's altar to its use.

decisions.choice: built the altar: rebuilt or restored it
decisions.reason: The altar of Yahweh already stood in the temple court (4:1; 29:18). To "build" it here is to repair it and make it fit for use again, after the years when other altars filled the courts (verses 4-5).

decisions.choice: peace offerings and thank offerings: sacrifices shared in a meal
decisions.reason: Peace offerings were eaten in part by the worshipers (Leviticus 3; 7:11-15), and the thank offering was a kind of peace offering given in thanks for help received (Leviticus 7:12). Manasseh thanks Yahweh for bringing him home.

decisions.choice: said to Judah to serve: commanded them to worship
decisions.reason: "Said" here has the force of a king's command, as in 14:3 and 29:21. To serve Yahweh is to worship him alone.

decisions.choice: rebuilt (Literal); restored (Balanced); repaired (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb is "build", but the altar already stood (m2), so each level says it was built again. Readable says "worship" for "serve" and "offerings to give thanks" for "thanksgiving".

decisions.choice: "reedificó" (L); "Restauró" (B); "Reparó" (R)
decisions.reason: The altar already stood (m2), so each level says it was built again, as the English does.

decisions.choice: sacrifícios de comunhão e de ação de graças (L, B); sacrifícios para agradecer a Deus (R)
decisions.reason: The peace offering is "sacrifício de comunhão", as the Old Testament terms set it, and the thank offering (m3) "ação de graças", as Leviticus 7:12 has it in Portuguese, with Readable's "para agradecer" as there.

source.text: אֲבָל֙ ע֣וֹד הָעָ֔ם זֹבְחִ֖ים בַּבָּמ֑וֹת רַ֖ק לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But still the people [were] sacrificing at the high places, only to Yahweh their God.

en.L: But still the people [were] sacrificing at the high places, only to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.
en.B: Even so, the people still sacrificed at the high places, though only to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.
en.R: But the people still offered sacrifices at the hilltop shrines, though they offered them only to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.

es.L: Pero el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios en los lugares altos, aunque solo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.B: Sin embargo, el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios en los lugares altos, aunque solo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.R: Pero el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios en los santuarios sobre las colinas, aunque se los ofrecía solo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios.

fr.L: Mais le peuple sacrifiait encore sur les hauts lieux, seulement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} leur Dieu.
fr.B: Pourtant, le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices sur les hauts lieux, mais seulement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} son Dieu.
fr.R: Mais le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices dans les sanctuaires sur les collines, même s’il les offrait seulement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, son Dieu.

sw.L: Lakini watu walikuwa bado wakitoa dhabihu mahali pa juu, kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao tu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu mahali pa juu, ingawa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao tu.
sw.R: Lakini watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu katika patakatifu pa kilimani, ingawa walimtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao tu.

vi.L: Nhưng dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế trên các nơi cao, chỉ dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.B: Dù vậy, dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế trên các nơi cao, dù chỉ dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.R: Nhưng dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế tại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao, dù họ chỉ dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của họ.

ko.L: 그러나 백성은 아직도 산당들에서 제사를 드리고 있었는데, 다만 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께만 [드렸다].
ko.B: 그런데도 백성은 여전히 산당들에서 제사를 드렸다. 다만 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께만 드렸다.
ko.R: 그러나 백성은 여전히 산꼭대기 제단들에서 제사를 드렸다. 다만 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께만 제물을 바쳤다.

pt.L: Mas ainda o povo [estava] sacrificando nos altos, somente {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus.
pt.B: Mesmo assim, o povo ainda oferecia sacrifícios nos altos, embora somente {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus.
pt.R: Mas o povo ainda oferecia sacrifícios nos santuários no alto dos morros, embora os oferecesse somente {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus.

decisions.choice: at the high places, only to Yahweh: right worship in the wrong place
decisions.reason: The people no longer sacrificed to other gods, but they still did so at local shrines, not at the one place Yahweh had chosen (Deuteronomy 12:13-14). Kings often says the same of kings who were otherwise faithful (1 Kings 15:14; 2 Kings 12:4; 15:4). Hezekiah had removed the high places (31:1), and Manasseh had rebuilt them (verse 3).

decisions.choice: but: a limit on the reform
decisions.reason: The word marks a contrast with what has just been said, as in 19:3: Manasseh's reform did not reach everything.

decisions.choice: hilltop shrines
decisions.reason: The settled Readable wording for the high places.

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁה֮ וּתְפִלָּת֣וֹ אֶל־אֱלֹהָיו֒ וְדִבְרֵי֙ הַֽחֹזִ֔ים הַֽמְדַבְּרִ֣ים אֵלָ֔יו בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנָּ֕ם עַל־דִּבְרֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and [the] words of the seers who spoke to him in [the] name of Yahweh [the] God of Israel, look, they [are] on [the] matters of [the] kings of Israel.

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, look, they [are] in the matters of the kings of Israel.
en.B: The rest of the acts of Manasseh, including the prayer he made to his God and what the seers said to him in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, are found in the Records of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Manasseh did, his prayer to his God, and the messages the seers gave him in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, are all in the records of the kings of Israel. (Seers were prophets who received messages from God.)

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Manasés, y su oración a su Dios, y las palabras de los videntes que le hablaron en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, he aquí [están] en los hechos de los reyes de Israel.
es.B: Los demás hechos de Manasés, incluida la oración que hizo a su Dios y lo que los videntes le dijeron en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, se encuentran en los Hechos de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Manasés, su oración a su Dios y los mensajes que los videntes le dieron en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, están en los registros de los reyes de Israel. (Los videntes eran profetas que recibían mensajes de Dios).

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Manassé, et sa prière à son Dieu, et les paroles des voyants qui lui parlèrent au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, voici, ils [sont] dans les actes des rois d’Israël.
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Manassé, la prière qu’il adressa à son Dieu et les paroles que les voyants lui dirent au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, se trouvent dans les Actes des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout ce que Manassé a fait d’autre, sa prière à son Dieu et les messages que les voyants lui ont donnés au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, tout cela se trouve dans les actes des rois d’Israël. (Les voyants étaient des prophètes qui recevaient des messages de Dieu.)

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Manase, na maombi yake kwa Mungu wake, na maneno ya waonaji waliosema naye kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, tazama, [yamo] katika mambo ya wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Manase, pamoja na maombi aliyomwomba Mungu wake na maneno ya waonaji waliosema naye kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, yameandikwa katika Kumbukumbu za Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Manase, maombi yake kwa Mungu wake, na ujumbe ambao waonaji walimpa kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, yote yamo katika kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli. (Waonaji walikuwa manabii waliopokea ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu.)

vi.L: Các việc khác của Ma-na-se, lời cầu nguyện của vua với Đức Chúa Trời mình, và lời của các nhà tiên kiến đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, nói với vua, kìa, đã được [chép] trong sách các việc của các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Các việc khác của Ma-na-se, kể cả lời cầu nguyện của vua với Đức Chúa Trời mình và những lời các nhà tiên kiến đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, nói với vua, đều được chép trong Sách Ký Sự Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Ma-na-se đã làm, lời cầu nguyện của vua với Đức Chúa Trời mình, và những sứ điệp các nhà tiên kiến đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, nói với vua, đều được chép trong sách ký sự các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. (Nhà tiên kiến là nhà tiên tri nhận sứ điệp từ Đức Chúa Trời.)

ko.L: 그리고 므낫세의 나머지 일들과, 그의 하나님께 드린 그의 기도와, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 그에게 말한 선견자들의 말들은, 보아라, 이스라엘 왕들의 일들에 [있다].
ko.B: 므낫세의 나머지 행적과 그가 그의 하나님께 드린 기도와, 선견자들이 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 그에게 한 말은 이스라엘 왕들의 행적에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 므낫세가 한 다른 모든 일과 그가 하나님께 드린 기도와, 선견자들이 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 그에게 전한 말씀은 모두 이스라엘 왕들의 기록에 들어 있다. (선견자는 하나님께 말씀을 받아 전하던 예언자였다.)

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Manassés, e a sua oração ao seu Deus, e as palavras dos videntes que lhe falaram em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, eis que estão nos atos dos reis de Israel.
pt.B: Os demais atos de Manassés, incluindo a oração que ele fez ao seu Deus e as palavras dos videntes que lhe falaram em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, estão nos Registros dos Reis de Israel.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Manassés fez, a sua oração ao seu Deus e as mensagens que os videntes lhe deram em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, está nos registros dos reis de Israel. (Os videntes eram profetas que recebiam mensagens de Deus.)

decisions.choice: the sources formula, in Chronicles' form; parallel to 2 Kings 21:17
decisions.reason: Kings speaks of "the rest of the matters of Manasseh and all that he did, and his sin", written in the record of the kings of Judah. Chronicles names instead his prayer and the words of the seers, and the record of "the kings of Israel". Chronicles calls the kings of Judah kings of Israel, since they were David's line and ruled what was left of Israel (20:34).

decisions.choice: his prayer to his God: the prayer of verses 12-13, not kept in the Bible
decisions.reason: The prayer itself is not given. A short prayer under Manasseh's name is found in some ancient Greek and Latin Bibles; it was written much later and is not part of the Hebrew Bible.

decisions.choice: the seers who spoke to him in the name of Yahweh: the prophets of verse 10
decisions.reason: "Seer" is an older title for a prophet, one to whom God shows things (1 Samuel 9:9). These are the messengers through whom Yahweh spoke to Manasseh (verse 10; 2 Kings 21:10). The same Hebrew word stands for Manasseh's "matters", the seers' "words" and the "matters" of the kings, that is, their recorded history.

decisions.choice: look, they are: pointing the reader to the record
decisions.reason: The pointing word draws attention to where the record can be found, as in 27:7.

decisions.choice: the matters (Literal); the acts, the Records of the Kings of Israel (Balanced); the records of the kings of Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: As for the sources formula elsewhere in Chronicles, Balanced says "the acts" for Manasseh's "matters" and writes the source as a title, and Readable keeps it plain. "Look" is carried by the plain statement.

decisions.choice: (Seers were prophets who received messages from God.)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "seer" once in this chapter, as at 19:2.

decisions.choice: "los hechos de los reyes de Israel" (L); "los Hechos de los Reyes de Israel" (B); "los registros de los reyes de Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles' source keeps the terms note's pattern: Balanced writes the source as a title, Readable says "registros", as the English does; Readable explains "vidente" once.

decisions.choice: "les actes des rois d'Israël" (Literal, Readable); "les Actes des rois d'Israël" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Chronicles names this source "the matters of the kings of Israel", not the "Annales" of Kings; Balanced writes it as a title.

decisions.choice: Kumbukumbu za Wafalme wa Israeli (B); kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles names this source "the matters of the kings of Israel"; Literal keeps "mambo", Balanced and Readable say "kumbukumbu" (records), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Sách Ký Sự Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B); "sách ký sự các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên" (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles names a source "the matters of the kings of Israel" (m1); "ký sự" (records) keeps it apart from Kings' "Lịch Sử" title and from "Sử Ký", the title of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 왕들의 일들" (Literal), "이스라엘 왕들의 행적" (Balanced), "이스라엘 왕들의 기록" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew title here is "the matters of the kings of Israel", a different name from the Kings sources, so it is kept apart from "실록" (terms note).

decisions.choice: o restante dos atos (L), Os demais atos (B), Tudo o mais que ... fez (R); as palavras dos videntes (L, B), as mensagens que os videntes lhe deram (R); os atos (L), os Registros (B), os registros (R) dos reis de Israel
decisions.reason: The source note keeps the wording 2 Kings 21:17 and 9:29 in Portuguese give it at each level, with what Chronicles names instead (m1): the prayer and "as palavras dos videntes", "vidente" as 16:7 and 19:2. Literal says "atos" for both uses of the one Hebrew word, as the English Literal says "matters" (m3); Balanced writes the source as a title, as the English does, and Readable explains "vidente" once, as 12:15 does.

source.text: וּתְפִלָּת֣וֹ וְהֵֽעָתֶר־לוֹ֮ וְכָל־חַטָּאת֣וֹ וּמַעְלוֹ֒ וְהַמְּקֹמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּנָ֨ה בָהֶ֤ם בָּמוֹת֙ וְהֶעֱמִיד֙ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֣ים וְהַפְּסִלִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י הִכָּנְע֑וֹ הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י חוֹזָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And his prayer and being entreated by him, and all his sin and his unfaithfulness, and the places where he built in them high places and set up the Asherahs and the carved images before he humbled himself, look, they [are] written on [the] words of Hozai.

en.L: And his prayer, and how [God] was entreated by him, and all his sin and his unfaithfulness, and the places where he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the carved images before he humbled himself, look, they [are] written in the words of Hozai.
en.B: His prayer and how God answered his plea, every sin and act of unfaithfulness, and the places where he built high places and erected Asherah poles and carved idols before he humbled himself, are written in the records of Hozai.
en.R: His prayer and how God answered it are written in the records of Hozai. So are all his sins and the ways he was unfaithful to God. They tell where he built hilltop shrines and set up poles used to worship Asherah and carved idols before he humbled himself.

es.L: Y su oración, y cómo [Dios] se dejó rogar por él, y todo su pecado y su infidelidad, y los lugares donde edificó lugares altos y puso postes de Aserá e imágenes talladas antes de humillarse, he aquí [están] escritos en las palabras de Hozai.
es.B: Su oración y cómo Dios atendió su súplica, todo su pecado y su infidelidad, y los lugares donde construyó lugares altos y levantó postes de Aserá e ídolos tallados antes de humillarse, están escritos en los Registros de Hozai.
es.R: Su oración y cómo Dios le respondió están escritos en los registros de Hozai. También lo están todos sus pecados y las maneras en que fue infiel a Dios. Allí se cuenta dónde construyó santuarios sobre las colinas y puso postes para adorar a Aserá e ídolos tallados antes de humillarse.

fr.L: Et sa prière, et comment [Dieu] se laissa fléchir par lui, et tout son péché et son infidélité, et les lieux où il bâtit des hauts lieux et dressa les poteaux d’Ashéra et les images sculptées avant de s’humilier, voici, ils [sont] écrits dans les paroles de Hozaï.
fr.B: Sa prière et la manière dont Dieu l’exauça, tous ses péchés et son infidélité, et les lieux où il bâtit des hauts lieux et dressa des poteaux d’Ashéra et des idoles sculptées avant de s’humilier, sont écrits dans les Récits de Hozaï.
fr.R: Sa prière et la manière dont Dieu y a répondu sont écrites dans les récits de Hozaï. On y trouve aussi tous ses péchés et toutes ses infidélités envers Dieu. Ces récits disent où il a construit des sanctuaires sur les collines, et où il a dressé des poteaux sacrés pour adorer la déesse Ashéra et des idoles sculptées, avant de s’humilier.

sw.L: Na maombi yake, na jinsi [Mungu] alivyokubali ombi lake, na dhambi yake yote na kukosa uaminifu kwake, na mahali alipojenga mahali pa juu na kusimamisha miti ya Ashera na sanamu za kuchonga kabla hajajinyenyekeza, tazama, yameandikwa katika maneno ya Hozai.
sw.B: Maombi yake na jinsi Mungu alivyojibu dua yake, kila dhambi yake na kila tendo la kukosa uaminifu, na mahali alipojenga mahali pa juu na kusimamisha miti ya Ashera na sanamu za kuchonga kabla hajajinyenyekeza, yameandikwa katika Kumbukumbu za Hozai.
sw.R: Maombi yake na jinsi Mungu alivyoyajibu yameandikwa katika kumbukumbu za Hozai. Vivyo hivyo dhambi zake zote na njia alizokosa uaminifu kwa Mungu. Kumbukumbu hizo zinaeleza mahali alipojenga patakatifu pa kilimani na kusimamisha miti iliyotumiwa kumwabudu Ashera na sanamu za kuchonga kabla hajajinyenyekeza.

vi.L: Lời cầu nguyện của vua và việc [Đức Chúa Trời] nhậm lời vua, mọi tội lỗi và sự bất trung của vua, các nơi vua đã xây các nơi cao, dựng các trụ A-sê-ra và các tượng chạm trước khi vua hạ mình, kìa, đã được chép trong lời của Hô-xai.
vi.B: Lời cầu nguyện của vua và việc Đức Chúa Trời đáp lời vua nài xin, mọi tội lỗi và sự bất trung của vua, cùng những nơi vua đã xây các nơi cao và dựng các trụ A-sê-ra và các tượng thần chạm trước khi vua hạ mình, đều được chép trong sách ký sự của Hô-xai.
vi.R: Lời cầu nguyện của vua và việc Đức Chúa Trời đáp lời vua đều được chép trong sách ký sự của Hô-xai. Mọi tội lỗi của vua và những cách vua đã bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời cũng được chép ở đó. Sách ấy kể những nơi vua đã xây các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao, dựng các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra và các tượng thần chạm trước khi vua hạ mình.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 기도와 [하나님께서] 그의 간구를 받아들이신 일과, 그의 모든 죄와 그의 신의를 저버린 일과, 그가 자신을 낮추기 전에 산당들을 짓고 아세라 목상들과 새긴 상들을 세운 곳들은, 보아라, 호새의 말들에 기록되어 있다.
ko.B: 그의 기도와 하나님께서 그의 간구를 들어주신 일, 그의 모든 죄와 신의를 저버린 일, 그리고 그가 자신을 낮추기 전에 산당들을 짓고 아세라 목상들과 새긴 우상들을 세운 곳들은 호새의 기록에 적혀 있다.
ko.R: 그의 기도와 하나님께서 그 기도에 응답하신 일은 호새의 기록에 적혀 있다. 그가 지은 모든 죄와 하나님께 신실하지 못했던 일들도 거기에 적혀 있다. 그가 겸손해지기 전에 산꼭대기 제단들을 짓고 아세라 목상들과 새긴 우상들을 세운 곳들도 거기에 적혀 있다.

pt.L: E a sua oração, e como [Deus] se deixou comover por ele, e todo o seu pecado e a sua infidelidade, e os lugares onde construiu altos e levantou os postes de Aserá e as imagens esculpidas antes de se humilhar, eis que estão escritos nas palavras de Hozai.
pt.B: A sua oração e como Deus atendeu ao seu pedido, todo o seu pecado e a sua infidelidade, e os lugares onde construiu altos e levantou postes de Aserá e ídolos esculpidos antes de se humilhar, estão escritos nos Registros de Hozai.
pt.R: A sua oração e a resposta de Deus estão escritas nos registros de Hozai. Ali também estão todos os seus pecados e as formas como ele foi infiel a Deus. Esses registros contam onde ele construiu santuários no alto dos morros e levantou postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá e ídolos esculpidos, antes de se humilhar.

decisions.choice: Hozai: the name in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "Hozai", a name found nowhere else. The ancient Greek translation reads "the seers", as in verse 18, and a slight change to the Hebrew letters would give that reading or "his seers". The Hebrew text is followed; if the other reading is right, the source is the same writings of the seers named in verse 18.

decisions.choice: being entreated by him: how God let himself be moved by Manasseh's prayer
decisions.reason: The verb of verse 13 is here a noun-like form with no stated subject; the one who was entreated is God.

decisions.choice: unfaithfulness: breaking faith with Yahweh
decisions.reason: The word means acting treacherously against one to whom loyalty is owed. Chronicles uses it for the sin that brought Saul down and later the exile (1 Chronicles 10:13; 2 Chronicles 28:19; 36:14).

decisions.choice: high places, Asherah poles, carved images before he humbled himself
decisions.reason: These are the works of verses 3-7. Chronicles records the sins as well as the prayer, and dates them to the time "before he humbled himself".

decisions.choice: how God answered his plea; carved idols; the Records of Hozai (Balanced); the records of Hozai (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one entreated (m2). As in verse 18, Balanced writes the source as a title. Readable splits the long list into sentences and puts the source first.

decisions.choice: Asherah poles, high places (Literal, Balanced); poles used to worship Asherah, hilltop shrines (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these words, as in verse 3.

decisions.choice: "Hozai"
decisions.reason: The name as the Hebrew text has it (m1), in Spanish spelling.

decisions.choice: "Hozaï"
decisions.reason: The name the Hebrew text has (m1), in the French form with a diaeresis.

decisions.choice: "호새", as the Hebrew text reads
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text is followed, as the English does (m1); "호새의 말들" (Literal) and "호새의 기록" (Balanced, Readable) follow the pattern of verse 18.

decisions.choice: se deixou comover (L), atendeu ao seu pedido (B); a sua infidelidade (L, B), foi infiel (R); Hozai
decisions.reason: The verb of verse 13 keeps its Portuguese at Literal, with "Deus" bracketed as the one entreated (m2). The breach of faith (m3) is "infidelidade", the word 1 Chronicles 10:13 and 12:2 use for it in Portuguese. The name "Hozai" (m1) is written as the Hebrew text has it, as the English does, and the source is a title at Balanced as in verse 18.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מְנַשֶּׁה֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בֵּית֑וֹ וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Manasseh with his fathers, and they buried him [in] his house; and reigned Amon his son in his place.

en.L: And Manasseh lay down with his fathers, and they buried him [at] his house, and Amon his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Manasseh rested with his ancestors, and they buried him at his palace. His son Amon became king in his place.
en.R: Then Manasseh died and was buried at his palace. His son Amon became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Manasés con sus padres, y lo sepultaron [en] su casa; y reinó en su lugar Amón su hijo.
es.B: Luego Manasés descansó con sus antepasados, y lo sepultaron en su palacio. Su hijo Amón reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Luego Manasés murió y fue sepultado en su palacio. Su hijo Amón lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Manassé se coucha avec ses pères, et on l’enterra [dans] sa maison ; et Amon son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Manassé reposa avec ses ancêtres, et on l’enterra dans son palais. Son fils Amon régna à sa place.
fr.R: Ensuite Manassé est mort et il a été enterré dans son palais. Son fils Amon est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Naye Manase akalala pamoja na baba zake, wakamzika [katika] nyumba yake; na Amoni mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Manase akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, wakamzika katika ikulu yake. Na mwanawe Amoni akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Manase akafa, akazikwa katika jumba lake. Na mwanawe Amoni akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Ma-na-se nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và người ta chôn vua [tại] cung của vua; A-môn con trai vua trị vì thay vua.
vi.B: Rồi Ma-na-se an giấc cùng tổ tiên, và người ta chôn vua tại cung điện của vua. A-môn con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Rồi Ma-na-se qua đời và được chôn tại cung điện của vua. A-môn con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 므낫세가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 사람들이 그를 그의 집에 묻었다. 그리고 그의 아들 아몬이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 므낫세는 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 사람들은 그를 그의 왕궁에 묻었다. 그의 아들 아몬이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 므낫세는 죽었고, 그의 왕궁에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아몬이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Manassés descansou com os seus pais, e o sepultaram [na] sua casa, e Amom, o seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Então Manassés descansou com os seus antepassados e foi sepultado no seu palácio. O seu filho Amom reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Então Manassés morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados. Ele foi sepultado no seu palácio. O seu filho Amom se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: buried at his house: 2 Kings 21:18 says "in the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says only "his house". Kings says Manasseh was buried in the garden of his palace, the garden of Uzza, not in the royal tombs in the City of David. The ancient Greek translation of Chronicles reads "in the garden of his house", as in Kings.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula, as in 2 Kings 21:18.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula as worded at each level. Balanced and Readable say "palace" for the king's "house"; Literal brackets "at", which the Hebrew leaves unsaid.

decisions.choice: descansou com os seus pais (L), antepassados (B); morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados (R); [na] sua casa (L), no seu palácio (B, R); Amom
alternatives: no jardim do seu palácio, o jardim de Uzá (as 2 Kings 21:18)
decisions.reason: The death formula keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 21:18 and the Readable form 16:13 sets for the book (m2); Chronicles says only "his house" for the burial (m1), and Literal says "o sepultaram" for its "they buried him", as 9:31. "Amom" as 2 Kings 21:18.

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וּשְׁתַּ֛יִם שָׁנָ֖ה אָמ֣וֹן בְּמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁתַּ֣יִם שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of twenty and two year[s was] Amon when he became king, and two years he reigned in Jerusalem.

en.L: Amon [was] a son of twenty-two years when he became king, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
en.B: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
en.R: Amon became king at the age of twenty-two, and he ruled in Jerusalem for two years.

es.L: Hijo de veintidós años [era] Amón cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó dos años en Jerusalén.
es.B: Amón tenía veintidós años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó dos años en Jerusalén.
es.R: Amón comenzó a reinar a los veintidós años, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante dos años.

fr.L: Amon [avait] vingt-deux ans quand il devint roi, et il régna deux ans à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Amon avait vingt-deux ans quand il devint roi, et il régna deux ans à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Amon avait vingt-deux ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant deux ans.

sw.L: Amoni [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka miwili huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Amoni alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka miwili huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Amoni alianza kutawala akiwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na miwili, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka miwili.

vi.L: A-môn [được] hai mươi hai tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì hai năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: A-môn được hai mươi hai tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì hai năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: A-môn lên làm vua lúc hai mươi hai tuổi, và vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem hai năm.

ko.L: 아몬이 왕이 되었을 때 22세[였고], 예루살렘에서 2년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 아몬은 22세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 2년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 아몬은 22세에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 2년 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: Amom [tinha] vinte e dois anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dois anos em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Amom tinha vinte e dois anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dois anos em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Amom tinha vinte e dois anos quando se tornou rei, e governou em Jerusalém durante dois anos.

decisions.choice: parallel to 2 Kings 21:19, without the queen mother
decisions.reason: The words are those of 2 Kings 21:19, which goes on to name Amon's mother, Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz from Jotbah. Chronicles leaves her out, as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: a son of twenty-two years: twenty-two years old
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

decisions.choice: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned two years
decisions.reason: Worded as in 2 Kings 21:19 at each level.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 21:19, without the queen mother
decisions.reason: The accession formula of 2 Kings 21:19 in Portuguese at each level, ending at "Jerusalém" since Chronicles leaves out the mother (m1), as in verse 1.

source.text: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֑יו וּֽלְכָל־הַפְּסִילִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֔יו זִבַּ֥ח אָמ֖וֹן וַיַּֽעַבְדֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, as had done Manasseh his father; and to all the carved images which had made Manasseh his father sacrificed Amon, and he served them.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as Manasseh his father had done; and Amon sacrificed to all the carved images that Manasseh his father had made, and he served them.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as his father Manasseh had done, offering sacrifices to all the carved idols his father had made and serving them.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, just as his father Manasseh had done. He offered sacrifices to all the carved idols his father Manasseh had made, and he worshiped them.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como había hecho Manasés su padre; y Amón ofreció sacrificios a todas las imágenes talladas que había hecho Manasés su padre, y les sirvió.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como lo había hecho su padre Manasés, y ofreció sacrificios a todos los ídolos tallados que su padre había hecho y les sirvió.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, igual que su padre Manasés. Ofreció sacrificios a todos los ídolos tallados que había hecho su padre Manasés, y los adoró.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme avait fait Manassé son père ; et Amon offrit des sacrifices à toutes les images sculptées qu’avait faites Manassé son père, et il les servit.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme l’avait fait son père Manassé ; il offrit des sacrifices à toutes les idoles sculptées que son père avait faites, et il les servit.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, comme son père Manassé l’avait fait. Il a offert des sacrifices à toutes les idoles sculptées que son père Manassé avait faites, et il les a adorées.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama Manase baba yake alivyofanya; na Amoni akatoa dhabihu kwa sanamu zote za kuchonga ambazo Manase baba yake alizifanya, akazitumikia.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama baba yake Manase alivyofanya, akitoa dhabihu kwa sanamu zote za kuchonga ambazo baba yake alizifanya na kuzitumikia.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, kama baba yake Manase alivyofanya. Alitoa dhabihu kwa sanamu zote za kuchonga ambazo baba yake Manase alizifanya, akaziabudu.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như Ma-na-se cha vua đã làm; A-môn dâng sinh tế cho mọi tượng chạm mà Ma-na-se cha vua đã làm, và phục vụ chúng.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như Ma-na-se cha vua đã làm. Vua dâng sinh tế cho mọi tượng thần chạm mà cha vua đã làm và phục vụ chúng.
vi.R: Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, giống như Ma-na-se cha vua đã làm. Vua dâng sinh tế cho mọi tượng thần chạm mà Ma-na-se cha vua đã làm, và thờ phượng chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 아버지 므낫세가 한 것처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다. 그리고 아몬은 그의 아버지 므낫세가 만든 모든 새긴 상에게 제사를 드리고 그것들을 섬겼다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지 므낫세처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다. 그는 그의 아버지가 만든 모든 새긴 우상에게 제사를 드리고 그것들을 섬겼다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지 므낫세처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그는 그의 아버지 므낫세가 만든 모든 새긴 우상에게 제물을 바치고 그것들을 섬겼다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como tinha feito Manassés, o seu pai; e a todas as imagens esculpidas que Manassés, o seu pai, tinha feito Amom ofereceu sacrifícios, e as serviu.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como o seu pai Manassés tinha feito, oferecendo sacrifícios a todos os ídolos esculpidos que o seu pai tinha feito e servindo-os.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau, assim como o seu pai Manassés tinha feito. Ofereceu sacrifícios a todos os ídolos esculpidos que o seu pai Manassés tinha feito, e os adorou.

decisions.choice: parallel to 2 Kings 21:20-21, more briefly and with sacrifice to the carved images
decisions.reason: The verdict is the same as in 2 Kings 21:20. Kings goes on to say that Amon walked in all his father's way, served the idols his father had served and bowed down to them, and forsook Yahweh (21:21-22). Chronicles says instead that he sacrificed to the carved images his father had made and served them.

decisions.choice: the carved images that Manasseh had made: the son takes up what the father had left
decisions.reason: These are the images Manasseh set up before he humbled himself (verse 19). Amon follows his father's early sin, not his repentance (verse 23). Verse 15 tells only of the foreign gods and the idol being removed from the temple; the text does not say where these images were.

decisions.choice: did the evil in [the] eyes of / did what was evil in the sight of / did what the LORD said was evil
decisions.reason: The verdict formula, worded as in 2 Kings 21:20. Readable says "worshiped" for "served".

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 21:20 for the verdict; imagens esculpidas (L), ídolos esculpidos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verdict is 2 Kings 21:20 in Portuguese at each level (m1); the sacrifice to the carved images is Chronicles' own, and the images keep the words of verse 19. Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with the images first.

source.text: וְלֹ֤א נִכְנַע֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כְּהִכָּנַ֖ע מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֑יו כִּ֛י ה֥וּא אָמ֖וֹן הִרְבָּ֥ה אַשְׁמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And not he humbled himself before Yahweh as humbled himself Manasseh his father, for he, Amon, increased guilt.

en.L: And he did not humble himself before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as Manasseh his father had humbled himself, but he, Amon, increased guilt.
en.B: Unlike his father Manasseh, he did not humble himself before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Instead Amon added more and more to his guilt.
en.R: But he did not humble himself before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the way his father Manasseh had. Instead, Amon kept adding to his guilt.

es.L: Y no se humilló delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como se había humillado Manasés su padre, sino que él, Amón, multiplicó la culpa.
es.B: A diferencia de su padre Manasés, no se humilló delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Al contrario, Amón aumentó cada vez más su culpa.
es.R: Pero no se humilló delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como lo había hecho su padre Manasés. Al contrario, Amón siguió aumentando su culpa.

fr.L: Et il ne s’humilia pas devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme s’était humilié Manassé son père, mais lui, Amon, multiplia la faute.
fr.B: Contrairement à son père Manassé, il ne s’humilia pas devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Au contraire, Amon ne cessa d’accroître sa culpabilité.
fr.R: Mais il ne s’est pas humilié devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme son père Manassé l’avait fait. Au contraire, Amon est devenu de plus en plus coupable.

sw.L: Wala hakujinyenyekeza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama Manase baba yake alivyojinyenyekeza, bali yeye, Amoni, akaongeza hatia.
sw.B: Tofauti na baba yake Manase, hakujinyenyekeza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Badala yake Amoni aliendelea kuongeza hatia yake zaidi na zaidi.
sw.R: Lakini hakujinyenyekeza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama baba yake Manase alivyofanya. Badala yake, Amoni aliendelea kuongeza hatia yake.

vi.L: Vua không hạ mình trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như Ma-na-se cha vua đã hạ mình, nhưng chính A-môn lại càng gia tăng tội lỗi.
vi.B: Không như Ma-na-se cha mình, vua không hạ mình trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Trái lại, A-môn càng ngày càng chồng chất tội lỗi.
vi.R: Nhưng vua không hạ mình trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như Ma-na-se cha vua đã làm. Trái lại, A-môn cứ phạm tội thêm mãi.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 아버지 므낫세가 자신을 낮춘 것처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 자신을 낮추지 않았고, 오히려 그, 아몬은 죄를 더했다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지 므낫세와 달리 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 자신을 낮추지 않았다. 오히려 아몬은 죄를 점점 더 쌓았다.
ko.R: 그러나 그는 그의 아버지 므낫세처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 겸손해지지 않았다. 오히려 아몬은 죄를 계속 더해 갔다.

pt.L: E ele não se humilhou diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como Manassés, o seu pai, tinha se humilhado, mas ele, Amom, aumentou a culpa.
pt.B: Ao contrário do seu pai Manassés, ele não se humilhou diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Pelo contrário, Amom aumentou cada vez mais a sua culpa.
pt.R: Mas ele não se humilhou diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como o seu pai Manassés tinha feito. Pelo contrário, Amom continuou aumentando a sua culpa.

decisions.choice: he did not humble himself as Manasseh had: the son is measured by his father's repentance
decisions.reason: This verse has no parallel in Kings. The word "humble himself" ties Amon's story to Manasseh's (verses 12, 19). The father sinned and turned back; the son sinned and did not.

decisions.choice: but he, Amon: the contrast is stressed
decisions.reason: After a negative, the conjunction means "but rather". The pronoun and name together set Amon over against his father.

decisions.choice: increased guilt: piled up guilt before Yahweh
decisions.reason: The word for guilt is one Chronicles uses for wrongdoing that brings Yahweh's anger on the people (24:18; 28:10, 13; 1 Chronicles 21:3). Amon added to it, and his death follows.

decisions.choice: added more and more to his guilt (Balanced); kept adding to his guilt (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "increased guilt" as ongoing and say "his" guilt, which is implied.

decisions.choice: não se humilhou (every level); aumentou a culpa (L), aumentou cada vez mais a sua culpa (B), continuou aumentando a sua culpa (R)
decisions.reason: "Humilhar-se" as in verses 12 and 19 (m1), so that the son is measured by his father's repentance in the same word. Balanced and Readable say the guilt grew, as the English does (m3).

records.literal_gloss: And conspired against him his servants, and they killed him in his house.

en.L: And his servants conspired against him, and they killed him in his house.
en.B: His officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.
en.R: Some of his officials made a plot against him, and they killed him in his palace.

es.L: Y sus siervos conspiraron contra él, y lo mataron en su casa.
es.B: Sus funcionarios conspiraron contra él y lo mataron en su palacio.
es.R: Algunos de sus funcionarios hicieron un complot contra él, y lo mataron en su palacio.

fr.L: Et ses serviteurs conspirèrent contre lui, et ils le tuèrent dans sa maison.
fr.B: Ses officiers complotèrent contre lui et le tuèrent dans son palais.
fr.R: Des officiers d’Amon ont comploté contre lui, et ils l’ont tué dans son palais.

sw.L: Nao watumishi wake wakafanya fitina juu yake, wakamwua ndani ya nyumba yake.
sw.B: Maafisa wake walifanya njama dhidi yake, wakamwua ndani ya ikulu yake.
sw.R: Baadhi ya maafisa wake walipanga njama dhidi yake, wakamwua ndani ya jumba lake.

vi.L: Các đầy tớ của vua âm mưu chống lại vua và giết vua trong cung vua.
vi.B: Các triều thần âm mưu chống lại vua và giết vua trong cung điện.
vi.R: Một số quan chức của vua lập mưu chống lại vua, và họ giết vua trong cung điện.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 신하들이 그를 대적하여 반역을 꾀하고, 그를 그의 집에서 죽였다.
ko.B: 그의 신하들이 그를 거슬러 반역을 꾀하고, 왕궁에서 그를 죽였다.
ko.R: 그의 신하 몇 사람이 그를 해치려고 음모를 꾸몄다. 그들은 왕궁에서 그를 죽였다.

pt.L: E os seus servos conspiraram contra ele e o mataram na sua casa.
pt.B: Os seus oficiais conspiraram contra ele e o mataram no seu palácio.
pt.R: Alguns dos seus oficiais fizeram uma conspiração contra ele e o mataram no seu palácio.

decisions.choice: parallel to 2 Kings 21:23
decisions.reason: The words are those of 2 Kings 21:23, except that Kings has "the servants of Amon" and "killed the king" where Chronicles has "his servants" and "killed him".

decisions.choice: his servants: his court officials
decisions.reason: "Servants" of a king are the officials of his court, as in 24:25, where Joash too was killed by his own officials. The text does not say why they acted.

decisions.choice: servants (Literal); officials (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As set for "the king's servants" in these books, and as in 2 Kings 21:23. Balanced and Readable say "palace" for the king's "house".

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 21:23
decisions.reason: The Portuguese of 2 Kings 21:23 at each level, with "os seus servos" (L), "os seus oficiais" (B, R) and "o mataram" where Chronicles has "his servants" and "killed him" (m1).

records.literal_gloss: And struck [the] people of the land all the [ones] conspiring against the king Amon, and made king [the] people of the land Josiah his son in his place.

en.L: And the people of the land struck down all those who had conspired against King Amon, and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
en.B: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and the people of the land made his son Josiah king in his place.
en.R: Then the people of the land killed everyone who had plotted against King Amon. They made Amon's son Josiah king in his place.

es.L: Y el pueblo de la tierra hirió a todos los que habían conspirado contra el rey Amón, y el pueblo de la tierra hizo rey en su lugar a Josías su hijo.
es.B: Entonces el pueblo de la tierra mató a todos los que habían conspirado contra el rey Amón, y el pueblo de la tierra puso como rey en su lugar a su hijo Josías.
es.R: Entonces el pueblo de la tierra mató a todos los que habían conspirado contra el rey Amón. Luego hicieron rey en su lugar a Josías, hijo de Amón.

fr.L: Et le peuple du pays frappa tous ceux qui avaient conspiré contre le roi Amon, et le peuple du pays fit roi Josias son fils à sa place.
fr.B: Alors le peuple du pays tua tous ceux qui avaient comploté contre le roi Amon, et le peuple du pays fit roi à sa place son fils Josias.
fr.R: Alors le peuple du pays a tué tous ceux qui avaient comploté contre le roi Amon. Ils ont fait roi Josias, le fils d’Amon, à sa place.

sw.L: Lakini watu wa nchi wakawapiga wote waliokuwa wamefanya fitina juu ya mfalme Amoni, nao watu wa nchi wakamtawaza Yosia mwanawe kuwa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha watu wa nchi wakawaua wote waliokuwa wamefanya njama dhidi ya mfalme Amoni, nao watu wa nchi wakamtawaza mwanawe Yosia kuwa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha watu wa nchi waliwaua wote waliopanga njama dhidi ya mfalme Amoni. Wakamtawaza Yosia, mwana wa Amoni, kuwa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Dân trong xứ đánh giết mọi kẻ đã âm mưu chống lại vua A-môn, và dân trong xứ lập Giô-si-a con trai vua làm vua thay vua.
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân trong xứ giết tất cả những kẻ đã âm mưu chống lại vua A-môn, và dân trong xứ lập Giô-si-a con trai vua làm vua kế vị.
vi.R: Bấy giờ dân trong xứ giết hết những kẻ đã lập mưu chống lại vua A-môn. Họ lập Giô-si-a con trai A-môn làm vua thay cha mình.

ko.L: 그러자 그 땅의 백성이 아몬 왕을 대적하여 반역을 꾀한 자들을 모두 쳐 죽였다. 그리고 그 땅의 백성이 그의 아들 요시야를 그를 대신하여 왕으로 삼았다.
ko.B: 그러자 그 땅의 백성이 아몬 왕에게 반역한 자들을 모두 죽였다. 그리고 그 땅의 백성은 그의 아들 요시야를 그의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 그러자 그 땅의 백성이 아몬 왕을 해치려고 음모를 꾸민 사람들을 모두 죽였다. 그들은 아몬의 아들 요시야를 그의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다.

pt.L: E o povo da terra feriu todos os que tinham conspirado contra o rei Amom, e o povo da terra fez Josias, o seu filho, rei em seu lugar.
pt.B: Então o povo da terra matou todos os que tinham conspirado contra o rei Amom, e o povo da terra fez do seu filho Josias rei em seu lugar.
pt.R: Então o povo da terra matou todos os que tinham conspirado contra o rei Amom. Depois fizeram Josias, filho de Amom, rei no lugar dele.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 21:24
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 2 Kings 21:24 and is worded as there. Chronicles has no parallel to Kings' closing notes on Amon's reign and burial (21:25-26); Josiah's reign begins at once in chapter 34.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the citizens of Judah as a body
decisions.reason: As in 23:13-21, the phrase means the free people of Judah, the landholders of the country, as distinct from the court in the palace. They act to keep David's line on the throne.

decisions.choice: Josiah his son: the king who will renew the covenant
decisions.reason: Josiah's reign, told in chapters 34-35, brings the greatest reform since Hezekiah's.

decisions.choice: the people of the land (every level)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 21:24, the phrase is kept at every level, since it names a group with a role of its own in Judah (m2). Readable says "They" the second time.

decisions.choice: "el pueblo de la tierra" (every level)
decisions.reason: As in Spanish 2 Kings 21:24, the phrase is kept at every level, since it names a group with a role of its own in Judah.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 21:24
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same (m1).

decisions.choice: o povo da terra (every level); Josias
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew as 2 Kings 21:24 (m1), and the same Portuguese at each level: "o povo da terra" kept as the name of a group with its own role (m2), and "Josias", the form 2 Kings 22:1 sets.
